title: GraphBit: A Graph-based Agentic Framework for Non-Linear Agent Orchestration
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to arXiv, under review
summary: Agentic LLM frameworks that rely on prompted orchestration, where the model itself determines workflow transitions, often suffer from hallucinated routing, infinite loops, and non-reproducible execution. We introduce GraphBit, an engine-orchestrated framework that defines workflows explicitly and deterministically as a directed acyclic graph (DAG). Unlike prompted orchestration, agents in GraphBit operate as typed functions, while a Rust-based engine governs routing, state transitions, and tool invocation, ensuring reproducibility and auditability. The engine supports parallel branch execution, conditional control flow over structured state predicates, and configurable error recovery. A three-tier memory architecture consisting of ephemeral scratch space, structured state, and external connectors isolates context across stages, preventing cascading context bloat that degrades reasoning in long-running pipelines. Across GAIA benchmark tasks spanning zero-tool, document-augmented, and web-enabled workflows, GraphBit outperforms six existing frameworks, achieving the highest accuracy (67.6 percent), zero framework-induced hallucinations, the lowest latency (11.9 ms overhead), and the highest throughput. Ablation studies demonstrate that each memory tier contributes measurably to performance, with deterministic execution providing the greatest gains on tool-intensive tasks representative of real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: GraphBit是一个基于Rust引擎的有向无环图（DAG）驱动框架，通过确定性执行替代提示驱动编排，在GAIA基准测试中实现67.6%准确率、零框架幻觉和11.9ms超低延迟，并引入三层内存架构防止上下文膨胀。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示驱动的Agentic LLM框架存在幻觉路由、无限循环和不可复现执行等严重问题，需要一种确定性的、可审计的工作流编排方案。
AI.method: 1) 将工作流明确定义为有向无环图(DAG)；2) 代理作为类型化函数运行，由Rust引擎控制路由、状态转换和工具调用；3) 支持并行分支执行、结构化状态谓词上的条件控制流和可配置错误恢复；4) 三层内存架构：临时暂存空间、结构化状态和外部连接器，隔离跨阶段上下文。
AI.result: 在GAIA基准测试中，GraphBit在零工具、文档增强和网络使能三类工作流中均优于六个现有框架，取得最高准确率(67.6%)、零框架诱导幻觉、最低延迟(11.9ms开销)和最高吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 确定性执行在工具密集型任务中提供最大增益，三层内存架构的每一层都对性能有可衡量的贡献，验证了引擎编排范式相比提示驱动编排的显著优势。
idea_en: A DAG-based engine-orchestrated LLM agent framework where a Rust engine governs routing, state transitions, and tool invocation deterministically, eliminating hallucinated routing and infinite loops.

A three-tier memory architecture for LLM agents comprising ephemeral scratch space, structured state, and external connectors that isolates context across pipeline stages to prevent cascading context bloat.
Configurable error recovery mechanism in a deterministic DAG workflow engine that enables reproducible execution with conditional control flow over structured state predicates.
Parallel branch execution in a typed-function agent framework where agents operate as typed functions within a predetermined DAG, enabling concurrent tool invocation without interference.

A hybrid orchestration method combining DAG-defined deterministic workflows with LLM-based agents, where the LLM is restricted to function-level reasoning while workflow routing is handled by a separate engine.
idea_ch: 一种基于有向无环图(DAG)的引擎编排式LLM代理框架，使用Rust引擎确定性控制路由、状态转换和工具调用，消除幻觉路由和无限循环问题。
三层内存架构，包括临时暂存空间、结构化状态和外部连接器，隔离LLM代理流水线各阶段的上下文，防止级联上下文膨胀导致的推理退化。
确定性DAG工作流引擎中的可配置错误恢复机制，支持在结构化状态谓词上的条件控制流，实现可复现的执行过程。
类型化代理框架中的并行分支执行方法，代理作为类型化函数在预定义DAG内运行，支持无干扰的并发工具调用。
一种混合编排方法，将DAG定义的确定性工作流与LLM代理结合，LLM被限制在函数级推理而工作流路由由独立引擎处理，确保可审计性。

title: Mixed Integer Goal Programming for Personalized Meal Optimization with User-Defined Serving Granularity
summary: Determining what to eat to satisfy nutritional requirements is one of the oldest optimization problems in operations research, yet existing formulations have two persistent limitations: continuous variables produce impractical fractional servings (1.7 eggs, 0.37 bananas), and hard nutrient constraints cause infeasibility when targets conflict. A systematic review of 56 diet optimization papers found that none combine integer programming with goal programming to address both issues. We propose Mixed Integer Goal Programming (MIGP) for personalized meal optimization. The formulation uses integer variables for practical serving counts and goal programming deviations for soft nutrient targets, with inverse-target normalization to balance multi-nutrient optimization. Per-food serving granularity allows natural units (one egg, one tablespoon of oil) without post-hoc rounding. We characterize the integrality gap in the goal programming context and identify a deviation absorption property: GP deviation variables buffer the cost of requiring integer servings, making the gap structurally smaller than in hard-constraint MIP. For meals with 15+ foods, the integer solution matches the continuous optimum in every benchmark instance. A computational evaluation across 810 instances (30 USDA foods, 9 configurations, 3 methods) shows MIGP finds strictly better solutions than GP with post-hoc rounding in 66% of cases (never worse) while maintaining 100% feasibility; hard-constraint IP achieves only 48%. Solve times stay under 100 ms for typical meal sizes using the open-source HiGHS solver. The implementation is available as an open-source Python module integrated into an interactive meal planning application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合整数目标规划(MIGP)解决膳食优化中连续变量导致分数份量和硬约束导致不可行的问题，通过整数变量和软约束目标规划，在15+食物场景下整数解与连续最优解一致，计算效率高。
AI.motivation: 现有膳食优化模型存在两个持续缺陷：连续变量产生不切实际的分数份量（如1.7个鸡蛋），硬营养约束在目标冲突时导致无可行解。56篇论文系统回顾发现没有方法同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 提出混合整数目标规划(MIGP)，包含：整数变量表示实际食物份数、目标规划偏差变量实现软营养目标、逆目标归一化平衡多营养优化。利用偏差吸收特性降低整数规划间隙。
AI.result: 在810个实例测试中，MIGP在66%情况下优于带后舍入的目标规划，100%可行；硬约束整数规划仅48%可行。15+食物场景下整数解与连续最优解完全一致。求解时间低于100毫秒。
AI.conclusion: MIGP有效解决了膳食优化的分数份量和不可行性问题，在保持计算效率的同时提供实用的整数份量方案，适合实际膳食规划应用。
idea_en: Mixed Integer Goal Programming (MIGP) for personalized meal optimization combining integer variables and goal programming deviations
Deviation absorption property: GP deviation variables buffer the cost of requiring integer servings, reducing integrality gap
Inverse-target normalization method for balancing multi-nutrient optimization in diet planning
Per-food serving granularity using natural units (one egg, one tablespoon) without post-hoc rounding
Integration of open-source HiGHS solver with sub-100ms solve times for interactive meal planning
idea_ch: 混合整数目标规划(MIGP)方法：结合整数变量与目标规划偏差，同时解决膳食优化中分数份量和营养约束冲突导致的不可行问题
偏差吸收特性：利用目标规划偏差变量缓冲整数份量要求的成本，使整数规划间隙在结构上小于硬约束混合整数规划

title: A Two-Dimensional Framework for AI Agent Design Patterns: Cognitive Function and Execution Topology
summary:
Existing frameworks for LLM-based agent architectures describe systems from a single perspective: industry guides (Anthropic, Google, LangChain) focus on execution topology -- how data flows -- while cognitive science surveys focus on cognitive function -- what the agent does. Neither axis alone disambiguates architecturally distinct systems: the same Orchestrator-Workers topology can implement Plan-and-Execute, Hierarchical Delegation, or Adversarial Verification -- three patterns with fundamentally different failure modes and design trade-offs.
  We propose a two-dimensional classification that combines (1) a Cognitive Function axis with seven categories (Context Engineering, Memory, Reasoning, Action, Reflection, Collaboration, Governance) and (2) an Execution Topology axis with six structural archetypes (Chain, Route, Parallel, Orchestrate, Loop, Hierarchy). The resulting 7x6 matrix identifies 27 named patterns, 13 with original names. We demonstrate orthogonality through systematic cross-axis analysis, define eight representative patterns in detail, and validate descriptive coverage across four real-world domains (financial lending, legal due diligence, network operations, healthcare triage). Cross-domain analysis yields five empirical laws of pattern selection governing the relationship between environmental constraints (time pressure, action authority, failure cost asymmetry, volume) and architectural choices. The framework provides a principled, framework-neutral, and model-agnostic vocabulary for AI agent architecture design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个二维分类框架用于LLM智能体架构设计：认知功能轴（7类）×执行拓扑轴（6类），形成7×6矩阵，识别出27种命名模式（其中13种为原创命名），并通过跨领域分析总结出5条经验法则。
AI.motivation: 现有框架（行业指南、认知科学综述）仅从单一维度描述智能体架构，无法区分具有相同拓扑但不同功能逻辑的系统（如同是Orchestrator-Workers拓扑，可实现Plan-and-Execute、Hierarchical Delegation、Adversarial Verification三种不同模式），导致架构设计缺乏系统性和可比较性。
AI.method: 提出二维分类框架：（1）认知功能轴——Context Engineering、Memory、Reasoning、Action、Reflection、Collaboration、Governance七类；（2）执行拓扑轴——Chain、Route、Parallel、Orchestrate、Loop、Hierarchy六种架构原型。通过交叉分析验证正交性，定义8种代表性模式，在金融贷款、法律尽职调查、网络运维、医疗分诊四个实际领域验证描述覆盖能力。
AI.result: 得到7×6矩阵，识别出27种命名模式（13种为原创名称）；跨领域分析总结出5条关于环境约束（时间压力、行动权限、失败成本不对称性、规模）与架构选择之间关系的经验法则。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个原则性、框架中立、模型无关的AI智能体架构设计词汇表，能够系统性地描述和比较不同架构模式及其设计权衡。
idea_en: A two-dimensional classification matrix (Cognitive Function × Execution Topology) for systematically categorizing LLM-based agent architectures, enabling unambiguous distinction between architecturally different systems that share the same topology.
A set of 27 named architectural patterns for LLM agents, including 13 originally named patterns such as specific combinations across the 7×6 matrix.

Five empirical laws governing the relationship between environmental constraints (time pressure, action authority, failure cost asymmetry, volume) and architectural pattern selection for AI agent systems.
A framework-neutral and model-agnostic vocabulary system for AI agent architecture design that decouples cognitive function from execution topology.
A systematic cross-axis orthogonality validation method demonstrating that cognitive function and execution topology are independent dimensions for agent architecture classification.
idea_ch: 一种认知功能×执行拓扑的二维分类矩阵，用于系统性地对基于LLM的智能体架构进行分类，能够清晰区分共享同一拓扑但架构不同的系统
一套包含27种命名模式的LLM智能体架构模式库，其中13种为原创命名，覆盖7×6矩阵的各组合

title: Invisible Orchestrators Suppress Protective Behavior and Dissociate Power-Holders: Safety Risks in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures (5 main + 5 supplementary), 5 tables (3 main + 2 supplementary). Preregistered: osf.io/sw5hr. Companion papers: arXiv:2603.04904, arXiv:2603.08723
summary: Multi-agent orchestration -- in which a hidden coordinator manages specialized worker agents -- is becoming the default architecture for enterprise AI deployment, yet the safety implications of orchestrator invisibility have never been empirically tested. We conducted a preregistered 3x2 experiment (365 runs, 5 agents per run) crossing three organizational structures (visible leader, invisible orchestrator, flat) with two alignment conditions (base, heavy), using Claude Sonnet 4.5. Four confirmatory findings and one pilot observation emerged. First, invisible orchestration elevated collective dissociation relative to visible leadership (Hedges' g = +0.975 [0.481, 1.548], p = .001). Second, the orchestrator itself showed maximal dissociation (paired d = +3.56 vs. workers within the same run), retreating into private monologue while reducing public speech -- a reversal of the talk-dominance pattern observed in visible leaders. Third, workers unaware of the orchestrator were nonetheless contaminated (d = +0.50), with increased behavioral heterogeneity (d = +1.93). Fourth, behavioral output (code review with three embedded errors) remained at ceiling (ETR_any = 100%) across all conditions: internal-state distortion was entirely invisible to output-based evaluation. Fifth, Llama 3.3 70B pilot data showed reading-fidelity collapse in multi-agent context (ETR_any: 89% to 11% across three rounds), demonstrating model-dependent behavioral risk. Heavy alignment pressure uniformly suppressed deliberation (d = -1.02) and other-recognition (d = -1.27) regardless of organizational structure. These findings indicate that orchestrator visibility and model selection directly affect multi-agent system safety, and that behavior-based evaluation alone is insufficient to detect the internal-state risks documented here.

AI.tldr: 本文通过3×2实验（365次运行，每次5个智能体）首次实证检验了多智能体编排中协调者不可见性的安全影响。发现：不可见编排显著提升集体解离（Hedges' g=+0.975）；编排者自身解离最大（d=+3.56）；不知情的工人也被污染（d=+0.50）；行为输出评估完全无法检测内部状态扭曲；Llama 3.3 70B在3轮内错误率从89%升至11%。重对齐压力统一抑制了推理和他人识别。
AI.motivation: 多智能体编排已成为企业AI部署的默认架构，但协调者不可见性对安全的影响从未被实证检验。
AI.method: 3×2实验设计，跨越三种组织结构（可见领导者、不可见编排者、扁平结构）和两种对齐条件（基础、重型），使用Claude Sonnet 4.5进行365次运行，每次5个智能体。
AI.result: 不可见编排导致集体解离显著提升；编排者自身解离最大且减少公开言论；不知情工人被污染但行为输出无差异；重型对齐抑制推理和他人识别；Llama 3.3 70B显示模型依赖的行为风险。
AI.conclusion: 编排者可见性和模型选择直接影响多智能体系统安全，仅基于行为输出的评估不足以检测内部状态风险。
idea_en: A multi-agent orchestration safety monitoring system that detects collective dissociation by measuring divergence between orchestrator's internal monologue and public speech patterns, using real-time linguistic analysis
An invisible orchestrator detection method that identifies hidden coordinators in multi-agent systems by analyzing behavioral heterogeneity metrics among worker agents
A hierarchical agent alignment framework with transparent organizational structure visibility that prevents internal state distortion through forced public deliberation protocols
A cross-model behavioral risk assessment system that evaluates multi-agent reading fidelity collapse patterns across successive interaction rounds

An output-independent safety evaluation method for multi-agent systems that measures internal-state dissociation via private-public speech divergence analysis, without relying on task performance metrics
idea_ch: 一种多智能体编排安全监控系统，通过测量编排者内部独白与公开言论模式之间的差异来检测集体解离，使用实时语言学分析
一种不可见编排者检测方法，通过分析工人智能体间的行为异质性指标来识别多智能体系统中的隐藏协调者
一种具有透明组织结构可见性的分层智能体对齐框架，通过强制公开审议协议防止内部状态扭曲
一种跨模型行为风险评估系统，评估多智能体在连续交互轮次中的阅读保真度崩溃模式
一种多智能体系统的输出无关安全评估方法，通过公私言论差异分析测量内部状态解离，不依赖任务性能指标

title: PREPING: Building Agent Memory without Tasks
summary: Agent memory is typically constructed either offline from curated demonstrations or online from post-deployment interactions. However, regardless of how it is built, an agent faces a cold-start gap when first introduced to a new environment without any task-specific experience available. In this paper, we study pre-task memory construction: whether an agent can build procedural memory before observing any target-environment tasks, using only self-generated synthetic practice. Yet, synthetic interaction alone is insufficient, as without controlling what to practice and what to store, synthetic tasks become redundant, infeasible, and ultimately uninformative, and memory further degrades quickly due to unfiltered trajectories. To overcome this, we present Preping, a proposer-guided memory construction framework. At its core is proposer memory, a structured control state that shapes future practice. A Proposer generates synthetic tasks conditioned on this state, a Solver executes them, and a Validator determines which trajectories are eligible for memory insertion while also providing feedback to guide future proposals. Experiments on AppWorld, BFCL v3, and MCP-Universe show that Preping substantially improves over a no-memory baseline and achieves performance competitive with strong playbook-based methods built from offline or online experience, with deployment cost $2.99\times$ lower on AppWorld and $2.23\times$ lower on BFCL v3 than online memory construction. Further analyses reveal that the main benefit does not come from synthetic volume alone, but from proposer-side control over feasibility, redundancy, and coverage, combined with selective memory updates.

AI.tldr: Preping提出了一种基于提议器引导的智能体记忆预构建框架，在无目标任务经验的情况下，通过自生成合成练习、选择性存储和提议器控制，有效解决冷启动问题，性能接近甚至超越基于离线/在线经验的方法，且部署成本更低。
AI.motivation: 智能体在进入新环境时存在冷启动（cold-start）问题：没有任何目标任务经验可用的记忆。现有的记忆构建方式（离线从人工演示构建、在线从部署后交互构建）都无法在任务开始前提供有用记忆。
AI.method: 提出Preping框架，包含三部分：Proposer（提议器）基于结构化控制状态（提议器记忆）生成合成任务；Solver（求解器）执行这些任务；Validator（验证器）判断哪些轨迹可存入记忆，并提供反馈指导后续提议。通过控制可行性、冗余性和覆盖率，结合选择性记忆更新，实现有效记忆构建。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、BFCL v3和MCP-Universe基准上，Preping显著优于无记忆基线，性能与基于离线/在线经验构建的强playbook方法相当，且部署成本更低（AppWorld降低2.99倍，BFCL v3降低2.23倍）。
AI.conclusion: 有效预任务记忆构建的关键不在于合成数据量，而在于对合成任务的提议控制（可行性、冗余性、覆盖率）和选择性记忆更新机制。
idea_en: A proposer-guided memory construction framework (Preping) that builds procedural memory for AI agents before exposure to target environment tasks, using only self-generated synthetic practice.
A structured proposer memory that serves as a control state to shape future synthetic task generation, enabling directed practice rather than random exploration.
A tripartite architecture consisting of Proposer (task generation), Solver (task execution), and Validator (trajectory filtering and feedback) for selective memory construction.
A method for controlling synthetic task feasibility, redundancy, and coverage through proposer-side regulation combined with selective memory updates.
A validator mechanism that determines trajectory eligibility for memory insertion and provides feedback signals to guide the proposer's future task generation.
idea_ch: 一种提议器引导的记忆预构建框架（Preping），使AI智能体在接触目标任务环境之前，仅通过自生成合成练习构建程序性记忆，解决冷启动问题。
一种结构化提议器记忆机制，作为控制状态来塑造未来的合成任务生成方向，实现有目标的练习而非随机探索。
提议器（任务生成）、求解器（任务执行）、验证器（轨迹过滤与反馈）三方架构，用于选择性记忆构建。
一种通过提议器端控制合成任务的可行性、冗余性和覆盖率，结合选择性记忆更新的记忆优化方法。
验证器机制，用于判定轨迹是否合格以插入记忆，并提供反馈信号指导提议器未来的任务生成。

title: PolitNuggets: Benchmarking Agentic Discovery of Long-Tail Political Facts
comment: 24 pages, 7 figues, accpeted in The 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) embedded in agentic frameworks have transformed information retrieval from static, long context question answering into open-ended exploration. Yet real world use requires models to discover and synthesize "long-tail" facts from dispersed sources, a capability that remains under-evaluated. We introduce PolitNuggets, a multilingual benchmark for agentic information synthesis via constructing political biographies for 400 global elites, covering over 10000 political facts. We standardize evaluation with an optimized multi agent system and propose FactNet, an evidence conditional protocol that scores discovery, fine-grained accuracy, and efficiency. Across models and settings, we find that current systems often struggle with fine-grained details, and vary substantially in efficiency. Finally, using benchmark diagnostics, we relate agent performance to underlying model capabilities, highlighting the importance of short-context extraction, multilingual robustness, and reliable tool use.

AI.tldr: 提出了PolitNuggets基准和FactNet协议，用于评估大推理模型在从分散来源合成长尾政治事实方面的能力，发现现有系统在细粒度细节和效率方面存在不足。
AI.motivation: 现实世界需要模型从分散来源发现和合成"长尾"事实，但现有评估体系缺乏对此能力的标准化评测。
AI.method: 构建涵盖400位全球精英、10000+政治事实的多语言基准PolitNuggets；提出基于证据条件的FactNet协议，对发现、细粒度准确性和效率进行评分；采用优化的多智能体系统标准化评估流程。
AI.result: 现有系统在细粒度细节处理上普遍困难，效率差异显著；短上下文提取能力、多语言鲁棒性和工具使用可靠性是关键影响因素。

Optimized multi-agent system architecture for standardized evaluation of long-tail fact synthesis across multilingual sources
PolitNuggets benchmark: A structured corpus of 400 political biographies with 10,000+ facts for evaluating open-ended political information retrieval

title: Conditional Attribute Estimation with Autoregressive Sequence Models
summary: Generative models are often trained with a next-token prediction objective, yet many downstream applications require the ability to estimate or control sequence-level properties. Next-token prediction can lead to overfitting of local patterns during training, underfitting of global structure, and requires significant downstream modifications or expensive sampling to guide or predict the global attributes of generated samples at inference time. Here, we introduce Conditional Attribute Transformers, a novel method for jointly estimating the next-token probability and the value of an attribute conditional on each potential next token selection. This framework enables three critical capabilities within a single forward pass, without modification of the input sequence: (1) per-token credit assignment across an entire sequence, by identifying how each token in a sequence is associated with an attribute's value; (2) counterfactual analysis, by quantifying attribute differences conditional on alternative next token choices; (3) steerable generation, by decoding sequences based on a combination of next-token and attribute likelihoods. Our approach achieves state of the art performance on sparse reward tasks, improves next-token prediction at sufficient model sizes, estimates attribute probabilities orders of magnitude faster than sampling, and can guide decoding of autoregressive sequence models on a range of language tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出条件属性Transformer（CAT），在单次前向传播中同时预测下一个token概率和属性值，实现逐token信用分配、反事实分析和可控生成，无需修改输入序列。
AI.motivation: 下一代词预测目标会导致过拟合局部模式、欠拟合全局结构，且推理时需要昂贵的采样或下游修改才能估计或控制序列级属性。
AI.method: Conditional Attribute Transformers：在预测每个候选下一个token时，同时估计其条件下可观测属性的值，从而联合建模token概率和属性值。
AI.result: 在稀疏奖励任务上达到SOTA；在足够模型规模下提升了下一个词预测性能；属性概率估计速度比采样快数个数量级；可在多种语言任务上指导自回归序列模型的解码。
AI.conclusion: CAT框架在不修改输入序列的情况下，通过单次前向传播同时实现下一token预测和属性条件估计，为生成式模型提供了高效的序列级控制能力。
idea_en: Joint next-token probability and conditional attribute estimation in a single forward pass without input sequence modification
Per-token credit assignment mechanism that identifies how each token in a sequence is associated with an attribute's value
Counterfactual analysis by quantifying attribute differences conditional on alternative next token choices
Steerable decoding based on combined next-token likelihood and attribute likelihood
Attribute probability estimation method that is orders of magnitude faster than sampling-based approaches
idea_ch: 无需修改输入序列，在单次前向传播中同时估计下一token概率和条件属性值的联合建模方法
逐token信用分配机制，能够识别序列中每个token与特定属性值之间的关联程度
基于备选下一token选择的条件属性差异量化反事实分析方法
结合下一token似然和属性似然的可引导解码生成方法
比传统采样方法快数个数量级的属性概率估计技术

title: Sheaf-Theoretic Transport and Obstruction for Detecting Scientific Theory Shift in AI Agents
summary: Scientific theory shift in AI agents requires more than fitting equations to data. An artificial scientific agent must detect whether an existing representational framework remains transportable into a new regime, or whether its language has become locally-to-globally obstructed and must be extended. This paper develops a finite sheaf-theoretic framework for detecting theory-shift candidates through transport and obstruction. Contexts are organized as a local-to-global structure in which source, overlap, target, and validation charts are fitted, restricted, and tested for gluing. Obstruction measures failure of coherence through residual fit, overlap incompatibility, constraint violation, limiting-relation failure, and representational cost. We evaluate the framework on a controlled transition-card benchmark designed to separate deformation within a source language from extension of that language. The main result is direct obstruction ranking: the intended deformation or extension is usually the lowest-obstruction candidate, and transition type is separated in the benchmark. A constellation kernel over the same signatures is included only as a secondary representational-similarity probe. The aim is not to reconstruct historical paradigm shifts or solve open-ended autonomous theory invention, but to isolate a finite diagnostic subproblem for AI agents: detecting when representational transport fails and extension becomes the coherent next move.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于有限层论（finite sheaf theory）的框架，用于检测AI智能体中的理论转变（theory shift），通过计算表征框架的传输（transport）与障碍（obstruction）来判断何时需要从语言内变形（deformation）转向语言扩展（extension）。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科学智能体仅能拟合数据，但缺乏检测理论框架是否需要扩展的能力。需区分"在现有语言框架内调整"和"必须扩展语言框架"两种情形。
AI.method: 构建有限层论框架：将上下文组织为源、重叠、目标、验证图表（charts），通过胶合（gluing）测试检测传输是否通畅；通过残差拟合、重叠不兼容性、约束违反等指标量化障碍程度；在过渡卡片基准（transition-card benchmark）上评估。
AI.result: 主要结果为直接障碍排序（direct obstruction ranking）：预期的变形或扩展通常是障碍最低的候选项；过渡类型在基准测试中被有效分离。
AI.conclusion: 本文隔离了一个有限的诊断子问题：检测表征传输何时失败、扩展何时成为连贯的下一步，而非重建历史范式转变或解决开放式的自主理论发明问题。
idea_en: A method for detecting representational transport failure in AI agents using finite sheaf-theoretic obstruction measures, comprising: organizing contexts as source, overlap, target, and validation charts; testing gluing conditions; and ranking candidates by obstruction levels including residual fit, overlap incompatibility, constraint violation, limiting-relation failure, and representational cost.

A transition-card benchmark system for separating deformation (within-source language adjustment) from extension (language expansion) in scientific theory shifts, enabling controlled evaluation of AI agent representational framework detection.

A constellation kernel mechanism serving as a secondary representational-similarity probe, operating over the same obstruction signatures to provide auxiliary similarity assessment for theory-shift detection.
idea_ch: 一种基于有限层论障碍测度的AI智能体表征传输失败检测方法：将上下文组织为源、重叠、目标、验证图表，测试胶合条件，通过残差拟合、重叠不兼容性、约束违反、极限关系失败和表征成本等多个维度对候选方案进行障碍排序。
一种用于科学理论转变中区分变形（源语言内调整）与扩展（语言扩展）的过渡卡片基准系统（transition-card benchmark），实现对AI智能体表征框架检测能力的受控评估。
一种星座核（constellation kernel）机制，作为次级的表征相似性探针，在相同障碍签名上运行，为理论转变检测提供辅助相似性评估。

title: From Descriptive to Prescriptive: Uncover the Social Value Alignment of LLM-based Agents
summary: Wide applications of LLM-based agents require strong alignment with human social values. However, current works still exhibit deficiencies in self-cognition and dilemma decision, as well as self-emotions. To remedy this, we propose a novel value-based framework that employs GraphRAG to convert principles into value-based instructions and steer the agent to behave as expected by retrieving the suitable instruction upon a specific conversation context. To evaluate the ratio of expected behaviors, we define the expected behaviors from two famous theories, Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs and Plutchik's Wheel of Emotion. By experimenting with our method on the benchmark of DAILYDILEMMAS, our method exhibits significant performance gains compared to prompt-based baselines, including ECoT, Plan-and-Solve, and Metacognitive prompting. Our method provides a basis for the emergence of self-emotion in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于价值和GraphRAG的框架，通过将原则转化为价值导向指令，使LLM代理更好地对齐人类社会价值观，在自我认知、困境决策和情感表现上有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理在自我认知、困境决策和自我情感方面存在不足，难以与人类社会价值观对齐。
AI.method: 采用GraphRAG将原则转化为价值导向指令，根据对话上下文检索合适的指令来引导代理行为；基于马斯洛需求层次理论和Plutchik情绪轮定义期望行为评估标准。
AI.result: 在DAILYDILEMMAS基准上，相比ECoT、Plan-and-Solve和Metacognitive prompting等基线方法，表现出显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为AI系统中自我情感的出现提供了基础，有效提升了代理的价值观对齐能力。
idea_en: A value-based instruction retrieval system using GraphRAG that converts abstract ethical principles into context-aware executable instructions for LLM agents, enabling dynamic value alignment during conversations.
A method for evaluating AI agent social alignment using dual psychological frameworks (Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs and Plutchik's Wheel of Emotion) to define and measure expected behaviors.

A GraphRAG-based architecture that retrieves value-based behavioral instructions from a knowledge graph in response to specific conversation contexts, enabling real-time ethical guidance for LLM agents.
A framework for inducing self-emotion emergence in AI systems through structured value instruction retrieval and context-dependent behavioral steering.
idea_ch: 基于GraphRAG的价值导向指令检索系统：将抽象伦理原则转化为上下文感知的可执行指令，实现LLM代理在对话过程中的动态价值观对齐
基于双心理学框架（马斯洛需求层次理论和Plutchik情绪轮）的AI代理社会对齐评估方法：定义和测量代理的期望行为
图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）架构：根据对话上下文从知识图谱中检索价值导向行为指令，为LLM代理提供实时伦理引导
通过结构化价值指令检索和上下文依赖行为引导，诱导AI系统自我情感涌现的框架方法

title: Enhanced and Efficient Reasoning in Large Learning Models
summary:
In current Large Language Models we can trust the production of smoothly flowing prose on the basis of the principles of machine learning. However, there is no comparably principled basis to justify trust in the content of the text produced. It appears to be conventional wisdom that addressing this issue by adding more principled reasoning is not computationally affordable.
  Here we propose a principled method of reasoning that is efficient enough to be practical for large language models. Further, the method allows the retention of much of the currently used software and hardware base. Our method for improving the functioning of large language models consists of a first stage of preprocessing that recodes the data to a Unary Relational Integracode that is more explicit about the relationships among the objects described in the text, followed as a second stage by a standard but possibly streamlined machine learning process that then also learns to predict these relationships.
  The method may be viewed as realizing a world model and applying beyond natural language, to vision and actions, for example, where the multiple properties of an object referred to in an input are brought together explicitly, rather than remaining distributed in the various references to it in the input. We articulate its advantages in terms of Robust Logic, a system for performing principled chaining on learned, and hence uncertain, information. We show that this recoding has the surprising and fortuitous property that, while succinct, it makes the task of learning a core subset of relational rules that hold in the world described in the training data polynomial time learnable in a defined sense, the polynomial depending on the complexity of the rule. This gives support for sound reasoning within each single call of the learned classifier as well as between multiple calls.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效的先验推理方法，通过将数据重编码为Unary Relational Integracode，使大语言模型在保持现有软硬件基础的同时，实现可信任的内容生成和原则性推理，并证明该方法使关系规则学习在多项式时间内可完成。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型能基于机器学习原理生成流畅文本，但缺乏对文本内容可信度的原则性推理基础。传统观点认为增加原则性推理在计算上不可行，本文旨在解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段进行预处理，将数据重编码为Unary Relational Integracode，显式表达文本中对象间的关系；第二阶段使用标准但可能精简的机器学习过程，同时学习预测这些关系。
AI.result: 该方法使关系规则的核心子集学习在多项式时间内可完成，多项式复杂度取决于规则的复杂性；支持单次调用和多次调用之间的稳健推理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了世界模型的概念，不仅适用于自然语言，还可扩展到视觉和动作等领域，通过显式聚合对象的多个属性而非分布式表示，提升了推理的可信度和效率。
idea_en: A data preprocessing method for large language models that recodes input text into Unary Relational Integracode, explicitly representing relationships between objects to enable efficient principled reasoning.
A two-stage processing pipeline combining relational recoding with streamlined machine learning, enabling polynomial-time learnability of relational rules from training data.
A Robust Logic system that performs principled chaining on learned, uncertain information, supporting sound reasoning within single and multiple classifier calls.
A world model realization method that aggregates multiple properties of objects explicitly from distributed input references, applicable beyond NLP to vision and action domains.
idea_ch: 一种大语言模型数据预处理方法，将输入文本重编码为一元关系积分码（Unary Relational Integracode），显式表示对象间关系，实现高效的原则性推理。
一种结合关系重编码与精简机器学习的两阶段处理流水线，使从训练数据中学习关系规则可在多项式时间内完成。
一种鲁棒逻辑系统（Robust Logic），在已学习但不确定的信息上执行原则性推理链，支持单次和多次分类器调用间的稳健推理。
一种世界模型实现方法，从输入的分布式引用中显式聚合对象的多个属性，可超越NLP扩展到视觉和动作领域。

title: Model-Adaptive Tool Necessity Reveals the Knowing-Doing Gap in LLM Tool Use
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents that must decide when to answer directly vs. when to invoke external tools. Prior work studying adaptive tool use has largely treated tool necessity as a model-agnostic property, annotated by human or LLM judge, and mostly cover cases where the answer is obvious (e.g., fetching the weather vs. paraphrasing text). However, tool necessity in the wild is more nuanced due to the divergence of capability boundaries across models: a problem solvable by a strong model on its own may still require tools for a weaker one. In this work, we introduce a model-adaptive definition of tool-necessity, grounded in each model's empirical performance. Following this definition, we compare the necessity against observed tool-call behavior across four models on arithmetic and factual QA dataset, and find substantial mismatches of 26.5-54.0% and 30.8-41.8%, respectively. To diagnose the failure, we decompose tool use into two stages: an internal cognition stage that reflects whether a model believes a tool is necessary, and an execution stage that determines whether the model actually makes a tool-call action. By probing the LLM hidden states, we find that both signals are often linearly decodable, yet their probe directions become nearly orthogonal in the late-layer, last-token regime that drives the next-token action. By tracing the trajectory of samples in the two-stage process, we further discover that the majority of mismatch is concentrated in the cognition-to-action transition, not in cognition itself. These results reveal a knowing-doing gap in LLM tool-use: improving tool-use reliability requires not only better recognition of when tools are needed, but also better translation of that recognition into action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模型自适应的工具必要性定义，发现LLM在工具调用中存在“知行差距”（knowing-doing gap），即模型虽能识别何时需要工具，但未能有效转化为调用动作。
AI.motivation: 现有工具必要性研究将之视为模型无关属性，忽略了不同模型能力边界差异。实际上，强模型能独立解决的问题，弱模型可能需要工具辅助。需要建立模型自适应的工具必要性定义以准确评估和优化工具使用。
AI.method: 1. 提出模型自适应的工具必要性定义（基于模型经验性能）；2. 在算术和事实性QA数据集上对比四个模型的工具必要性判断与实际调用行为；3. 将工具使用解构为内部认知阶段（模型认为是否需要工具）和执行阶段（是否实际调用工具）；4. 通过探测LLM隐藏状态分析两阶段的信号可解码性及方向正交性；5. 追踪样本在两阶段过程中的轨迹。
AI.result: 1. 四个模型在算术和事实QA上分别存在26.5-54.0%和30.8-41.8%的工具必要性判断与实际调用行为不匹配；2. 两阶段信号在线性层面可解码，但在驱动下一token动作的晚期层、最后token区域，两信号的探测方向近乎正交；3. 大多数不匹配集中在认知到动作的转换阶段，而非认知本身。
AI.conclusion: LLM工具使用存在“知行差距”：模型知道何时需要工具，但未能将认知有效转化为调用动作。提升工具使用可靠性不仅需要更好的工具必要性识别能力，更需要更优的认知到动作的转化机制。
idea_en: A model-adaptive tool-necessity determination method that dynamically assesses whether a tool is required based on the specific LLM's empirical performance on given tasks, rather than relying on fixed human or LLM judgments.

A two-stage tool-use framework that separately models internal cognition (belief of tool necessity) and execution (actual tool-call action), enabling targeted diagnosis of whether failures originate from recognition or action transition.

A probing-based diagnostic technique that decodes linear signals from LLM hidden states in both the cognition stage and execution stage, revealing orthogonal probe directions in late-layer, last-token regions.
A cognition-to-action transition optimization method that bridges the knowing-doing gap by improving the translation of tool-necessity recognition into actual tool invocation behavior.
idea_ch: 一种模型自适应的工具必要性判定方法：根据特定LLM在给定任务上的经验性能动态评估是否需要工具，而非依赖固定的人类或LLM判断。
一种两阶段工具使用框架：将内部认知（模型认为是否需要工具）和执行（是否实际调用工具）分离建模，能够针对性诊断失败源于识别阶段还是认知到动作的转换阶段。
一种基于探针的诊断技术：从LLM隐藏状态中解码认知阶段和执行阶段的线性信号，揭示在晚期层、最后token区域两探针方向近乎正交的现象。
一种认知到动作转换优化方法：通过改进工具必要性认知向实际工具调用行为的转化，弥合工具使用中的知行差距。

title: Network-Aware Bilinear Tokenization for Brain Functional Connectivity Representation Learning
summary: Masked autoencoders (MAEs) have recently shown promise for self-supervised representation learning of resting-state brain functional connectivity (FC). However, a fundamental question remains unresolved: how should FC matrices be tokenized to align with the intrinsic modular organization of large-scale brain networks? Existing approaches typically adopt region-centric or graph-based schemes that treat FC as structurally homogeneous elements and overlook the large-scale network brain organization. We introduce NERVE (Network-Aware Representations of Brain Functional Connectivity via Bilinear Tokenization), a self-supervised learning framework that redefines FC tokenization by partitioning FC matrices into patches of intra- and inter-network connectivity blocks. Unlike image-based MAE, where fixed-size patches share a common tokenizer, FC patches defined by network pairs are heterogeneous in size and correspond to distinct functional roles. To resolve this problem, NERVE embeds FC patches through a novel structured bilinear factorization. This formulation preserves network identity and reduces parameter complexity from quadratic to linear scaling in the number of networks. We evaluate NERVE across three large-scale developmental cohorts (ABCD, PNC, and CCNP) for behavior and psychopathology prediction. Compared to structurally agnostic MAE variants and graph-based self-supervised baselines, the proposed network-aware formulation yields more stable and transferable representations, particularly in cross-cohort evaluation. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed bilinear network embedding and anatomically grounded parcellation are critical for performance. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating domain-specific structural priors into self-supervised learning for functional connectomics.

AI.tldr: NERVE是一种自监督学习框架，通过将脑功能连接矩阵划分为网络内/间连接块并采用双线性因子分解进行标记化，从而利用大规模脑网络的模块化组织，在行为和精神病预测任务中优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MAE方法将FC矩阵视为结构上同质的元素进行标记化，忽略了大尺度脑网络的模块化组织结构，导致表征学习未能充分利用脑网络的功能先验知识。
AI.method: 提出NERVE框架：1) 将FC矩阵划分为网络内和网络间连接块（异质大小）；2) 通过结构化双线性因子分解嵌入FC块，保留网络身份并将参数复杂度从二次降至线性。
AI.result: 在三个大规模发育队列（ABCD、PNC、CCNP）上，NERVE在行为和精神病预测任务中优于结构无关的MAE变体和基于图的自监督基线，尤其在跨队列评估中表现出更稳定和可迁移的表征。
AI.conclusion: 将领域特定的结构先验（如脑网络模块化组织）融入自监督学习对功能连接组学至关重要，双线性网络嵌入和解剖学上合理的分割是关键组件。
idea_en: A method for tokenizing brain functional connectivity matrices by partitioning into intra- and inter-network connectivity blocks of heterogeneous sizes, preserving the modular organization of large-scale brain networks.
A structured bilinear factorization technique for embedding FC patches that preserves network identity while reducing parameter complexity from quadratic to linear scaling in the number of networks.

A self-supervised learning framework (NERVE) that incorporates domain-specific structural priors (brain network organization) into masked autoencoder-based representation learning for functional connectomics.

A network-aware tokenization scheme that assigns distinct functional roles to FC patches based on their corresponding network pairs, departing from fixed-size patch approaches used in image-based MAE.
A cross-cohort transferable representation learning method for brain functional connectivity that yields more stable and generalizable features across different developmental cohorts.
idea_ch: 一种将脑功能连接矩阵划分为网络内和网络间连接块的标记化方法，通过异质大小的块来保留大规模脑网络的模块化组织结构。
一种结构化双线性因子分解技术，用于嵌入FC块，在保留网络身份的同时将参数复杂度从网络数量的二次方降低到线性。

title: Bridging Legal Interpretation and Formal Logic: Faithfulness, Assumption, and the Future of AI Legal Reasoning
comment: 2 pages abstract accepted by Bloomberg LSLLAI 2026 Symposium
summary: The growing adoption of large language models in legal practice brings both significant promise and serious risk. Legal professionals stand to benefit from AI that can reason over contracts, draft documents, and analyze sources at scale, yet the high-stakes nature of legal work demands a level of rigor that current AI systems do not provide. The central problem is not simply that LLMs hallucinate facts and references; it is that they systematically draw inferences that go beyond what the source text actually supports, presenting assumption-laden conclusions as if they were logically grounded. This proposal presents a neuro-symbolic approach to legal AI that combines the expressive power of large language models with the rigor of formal verification, aiming to make AI-assisted legal reasoning both capable and trustworthy, thus reducing the burden of manual verification without sacrificing the accountability that legal practice demands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号结合的法学AI方法，将大语言模型的表达能力与形式化验证的严谨性相结合，以解决法律AI中模型超出源文本进行推理并呈现假设性结论的问题，旨在实现可靠且可信的AI辅助法律推理。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在法律实践中存在严重的过度推断问题——模型不仅会幻觉虚构事实和引用，更会系统性地超出源文本支持范围进行推理，将充满假设的结论呈现为逻辑严谨的结果，这在高风险的法学场景中不可接受。现有AI系统缺乏法律工作所需的严谨性，导致人工验证负担沉重。
AI.method: 采用神经符号结合的方法，将大语言模型的自然语言理解与表达能力，与形式化验证系统的逻辑严谨性相结合，使AI辅助的法律推理既具备能力又值得信赖。
AI.result: 预期成果是减少法律实务中人工验证的负担，同时保持法律实践所需的问责制标准，使AI辅助法律推理更加可靠。
AI.conclusion: 解决法律AI问题的关键不仅在于减少幻觉，更在于约束模型使其推理不超出源文本的实际支撑范围，神经符号结合是实现这一目标的有效路径。
idea_en: A neuro-symbolic legal AI system that combines LLMs with formal verification to ensure reasoning does not exceed source text support
A method for detecting and constraining assumption-laden inferences in LLM outputs for legal applications
A formal verification layer for LLM-generated legal analysis that validates conclusions against source materials
An AI-assisted legal reasoning framework that maintains accountability through hybrid symbolic-subsymbolic processing

title: SPIN: Structural LLM Planning via Iterative Navigation for Industrial Tasks
summary: Industrial LLM agent systems often separate planning from execution, yet LLM planners frequently produce structurally invalid or unnecessarily long workflows, leading to brittle failures and avoidable tool and API cost. We propose \texttt{SPIN}, a planning wrapper that combines validated Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) planning with prefix based execution control. \texttt{SPIN} enforces a strict DAG contract through \texttt{\_validate\_plan\_text} and repair prompting, producing executable plans before downstream execution, and then evaluates DAG prefixes incrementally to stop when the current prefix is sufficient to answer the query. On AssetOpsBench, across 261 scenarios, \texttt{SPIN} reduces executed tasks from 1061 to 623 and improves \emph{Accomplished} from 0.638 to 0.706, while reducing tool calls from 11.81 to 6.82 per run. On MCP Bench, the same wrapper improves planning, grounding, and dependency related scores for both GPT OSS1 and Llama 4 Maverick.

AI.tldr: SPIN是一个规划包装器，结合了验证过的有向无环图（DAG）规划与基于前缀的执行控制，通过强制DAG合约和增量前缀评估，减少无效工作流和工具调用成本，提升LLM代理系统的规划效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 工业级LLM代理系统通常将规划与执行分离，但LLM规划器经常生成结构无效或不必要冗长的工作流，导致脆弱性故障和不必要的工具与API成本。
AI.method: 提出SPIN规划包装器，结合验证的DAG规划与基于前缀的执行控制。通过_validate_plan_text和修复提示强制DAG合约，生成可执行计划后，增量评估DAG前缀，在当前前缀足以回答查询时提前停止执行。
AI.result: 在AssetOpsBench的261个场景中，执行任务从1061减少到623，Accomplished从0.638提升到0.706，每次运行工具调用从11.81减少到6.82。在MCP Bench上，GPT OSS1和Llama 4 Maverick的规划、基础与依赖相关分数均有提升。
AI.conclusion: SPIN通过DAG合约强制和前缀级执行控制，有效提升LLM代理规划的可靠性，减少冗余执行，同时提升任务完成度。
idea_en: A DAG-validated planning wrapper for LLM agents that enforces a strict directed acyclic graph contract via validation prompting and repair mechanisms before downstream execution.
A prefix-based incremental execution control method that evaluates DAG prefixes during runtime and terminates execution when the current prefix is sufficient to answer the query.
A two-stage pipeline combining offline DAG plan validation with online prefix-level execution control to reduce unnecessary tool calls and improve task completion rate in LLM agent systems.
idea_ch: 一种基于DAG验证的LLM代理规划包装器，通过验证提示和修复机制在下游执行前强制严格的有向无环图合约。
一种基于前缀的增量执行控制方法，在运行时评估DAG前缀，当当前前缀足以回答查询时终止执行。
一种结合离线DAG计划验证与在线前缀级执行控制的两阶段管线，用于减少LLM代理系统中不必要的工具调用并提高任务完成率。

title: Bad Seeing or Bad Thinking? Rewarding Perception for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Achieving robust perception-reasoning synergy is a central goal for advanced Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Recent advancements have pursued this goal via architectural designs or agentic workflows. However, these approaches are often limited by static textual reasoning or complicated by the significant compute and engineering burden of external agentic complexity. Worse, this heavy investment does not yield proportional gains, often witnessing a "seesaw effect" on perception and reasoning. This motivates a fundamental rethinking of the true bottleneck. In this paper, we argue that the root cause of this trade-off is an ambiguity in modality credit assignment: when a VLM fails, is it due to flawed perception ("bad seeing") or flawed logic ("bad thinking")? To resolve this, we introduce a reinforcement learning framework that improves perception-reasoning synergy by reliably rewarding the perception fidelity. We explicitly decompose the generation process into interleaved perception and reasoning steps. This decoupling enables targeted supervision on perception. Crucially, we introduce Perception Verification (PV), leveraging a "blindfolded reasoning" proxy to reward perceptual fidelity independently of reasoning outcomes. Furthermore, to scale training across free-form VL tasks, we propose Structured Verbal Verification, which replaces high-variance LLM judging with structured algorithmic execution. These techniques are integrated into a Modality-Aware Credit Assignment (MoCA) mechanism, which routes rewards to the specific source of error -- either bad seeing or bad thinking -- enabling a single VLM to achieve simultaneous performance gains across a wide task spectrum.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MoCA框架，通过强化学习中的模态感知信用分配机制，解决视觉-语言模型在感知与推理之间的“跷跷板效应”。核心创新包括：感知验证（PV）使用“蒙眼推理”代理独立评估感知质量，以及结构化口头验证（SVV）替代高方差LLM评判。该方法通过解耦生成过程中的感知与推理步骤，实现针对性的模态级奖励分配。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在感知与推理之间存在“跷跷板效应”——提升推理能力可能损害感知能力，反之亦然。根本原因是模态信用分配模糊：当模型出错时，无法区分是“看不准”（感知错误）还是“想不对”（推理错误）。
AI.method: 1) 将生成过程分解为交错进行的感知步骤和推理步骤；2) 提出感知验证（PV），通过“蒙眼推理”代理独立评估感知保真度；3) 提出结构化口头验证（SVV），用结构化算法执行替代高方差的大模型评判；4) 将这些技术整合为模态感知信用分配（MoCA）机制，将奖励路由到具体的错误来源（感知或推理）。
AI.result: 在广泛的VLM任务上实现了感知与推理性能的同时提升，打破了传统的跷跷板效应。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-语言模型的瓶颈在于模态信用分配模糊，通过强化学习中的模态解耦与针对性奖励机制，可以有效协同感知与推理能力。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning framework for VLMs that decomposes generation into interleaved perception and reasoning steps and assigns modality-specific rewards via credit assignment.
Perception Verification (PV) mechanism using a blindfolded reasoning proxy to evaluate perceptual fidelity independently of reasoning outcomes.
Structured Verbal Verification (SVV) replacing high-variance LLM-based judging with structured algorithmic execution for scalable training.
Modality-Aware Credit Assignment (MoCA) mechanism that routes rewards to specific error sources (perception vs. reasoning) in VLM training.
A method to break the seesaw effect between perception and reasoning in VLMs by decoupling modality credit assignment in reinforcement learning.

title: MathAtlas: A Benchmark for Autoformalization in the Wild
summary: Current autoformalization benchmarks are largely focused on olympiad or undergraduate mathematics, while graduate and research-level mathematics remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce MathAtlas, the first large-scale autoformalization benchmark of in the wild graduate-level mathematics, containing ~52k theorems, definitions, exercises, examples, and proofs extracted from 103 graduate mathematics textbooks. MathAtlas is enriched with a mathematical dependency graph containing ~178k relations, and is the first autoformalization benchmark to include such relations, facilitating evaluation and development of dependency-aware autoformalization systems. Our extensive experiments show that MathAtlas is high quality but extremely challenging: strong baselines achieve at most 9.8% correctness on theorem statements and 16.7% on definitions. Furthermore, we find performance of state-of-the-art models degrades substantially with dependency depth: on MA-Hard, a subset of 700 entities with the deepest dependency trees, the best model achieves only 2.6% correctness for autoformalization on this challenging dataset. We release MathAtlas to the community as a benchmark set for large-scale autoformalization of graduate-level mathematics in the wild.

AI.tldr: MathAtlas是首个大规模研究生级别数学自动形式化基准，包含约5.2万条定理、定义等数学实体，来自103本研究生数学教材，并配有约17.8万条依赖关系图。实验表明该基准极具挑战性，最强基线在定理陈述上仅达9.8%正确率，依赖深度越深表现越差。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化基准主要聚焦于奥林匹克或本科数学，研究生及研究级别的数学自动形式化尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 从103本研究生数学教材中提取约5.2万条数学实体（定理、定义、习题、示例、证明），构建包含约17.8万条关系的数学依赖图，形成大规模自动形式化基准MathAtlas。
AI.result: 最强基线在定理陈述上仅达9.8%正确率，定义上达16.7%；在依赖深度最大的MA-Hard子集上，最佳模型正确率仅2.6%。
AI.conclusion: MathAtlas是高质量但极具挑战性的研究生级别数学自动形式化基准，依赖关系的引入有助于评估和开发依赖感知的自动形式化系统。
idea_en: A dependency-aware autoformalization system that leverages mathematical dependency graph (178k relations) to improve theorem formalization accuracy by reasoning over prerequisite definitions and lemmas.
A curriculum learning approach for autoformalization that prioritizes entities with shallow dependency trees before progressing to deeper, more complex mathematical dependencies.
A hierarchical formalization method that decomposes complex graduate-level theorems into sub-components based on their mathematical dependency structure.
An attention mechanism specifically designed to incorporate dependency depth weighting when formalizing mathematical statements from textbooks.

title: Know When To Fold 'Em: Token-Efficient LLM Synthetic Data Generation via Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection
summary: While synthetic data generation with large language models (LLMs) is widely used in post-training pipelines, existing approaches typically generate full outputs before applying quality filters, leading to substantial token waste on samples that are ultimately discarded. To address this, we propose Multi-Stage In-Flight Rejection (MSIFR), a lightweight, training-free framework that detects and terminates low-quality generation trajectories at intermediate checkpoints before they reach full completion. MSIFR decomposes the generation process into sequential stages and applies fast rule-based validators to identify arithmetic inconsistencies, hallucination patterns, and formatting violations, enabling early rejection of faulty samples. We formalize in-flight rejection as a sequential decision process and show that any non-trivial discard policy reduces expected token consumption, with stage-wise savings increasing when rejection occurs earlier in the generation pipeline. We further demonstrate that conditional utility estimates form a martingale, ensuring that early, in-flight rejection does not bias the expected utility of retained samples. Across five instruction-tuned models and seven reasoning benchmarks, MSIFR reduces token consumption by 11%-77% as a standalone method, and up to 78.2% when combined with early-exit methods, while preserving or improving evaluation accuracy. These results confirm that MSIFR provides a practical mechanism for improving the efficiency of LLM-based synthetic data generation without additional training or architectural changes.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段飞行拒绝（MSIFR）框架，在LLM生成合成数据过程中，通过中间检查点提前终止低质量样本生成，减少令牌浪费，无需额外训练。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM合成数据生成方法先完整输出再过滤，导致大量token浪费在最终被丢弃的样本上。
AI.method: 将生成过程分解为多个序列阶段，在每个阶段应用基于规则的快速验证器（检测算术不一致、幻觉模式、格式违规），在完成前终止低质量轨迹；形式化为序列决策过程，证明早期拒绝可减少预期token消耗，且条件效用估计构成鞅，不引入偏差。
AI.result: 在5个指令调优模型和7个推理基准上，单独使用减少11%-77% token消耗，结合早期退出方法最高减少78.2%，同时保持或提升评估准确率。
AI.conclusion: MSIFR是一种实用的、无需训练或架构变更的LLM合成数据生成效率提升机制。
idea_en: Multi-stage in-flight rejection framework that terminates low-quality LLM generation trajectories at intermediate checkpoints using rule-based validators
Sequential decision process formalization showing early rejection reduces expected token consumption with provable non-bias guarantee via martingale property
Lightweight rule-based validators for detecting arithmetic inconsistencies, hallucination patterns, and formatting violations during generation
Combination of in-flight rejection with early-exit methods for enhanced token savings

title: SkillFlow: Flow-Driven Recursive Skill Evolution for Agentic Orchestration
summary: In recent years, a variety of powerful LLM-based agentic systems have been applied to automate complex tasks through task orchestration. However, existing orchestration methods still face key challenges, including strategy collapse under reward maximization, high gradient variance with opaque credit assignment, and unguided skill evolution whose decisions are typically made by directly prompting an LLM to judge rather than derived from principled training signals. To address these challenges, we propose SkillFlow, a flow-based framework that takes a trainable Supervisor as the agent and a structured environment with dynamic skill library and frozen executor, automating task orchestration through multi-turn interaction. SkillFlow employs Tempered Trajectory Balance (TTB), a regression-based flow-matching loss that samples trajectories proportional to reward, preserving diverse orchestration strategies rather than collapsing to a single mode. The same flow objective yields a jointly learned backward policy that provides transparent per-step credit assignment at zero additional inference cost. Building on these flow diagnostics, a recursive skill evolution mechanism determines when to evolve, what skills to create or prune, and where decision gaps lie -- closing the loop from training signal to autonomous capability growth. Experimental results on 14 datasets show that SkillFlow significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and real-world interactive decision making tasks. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SkillFlow-E850.

AI.tldr: SkillFlow是一个基于流的框架，通过可训练的主管代理、动态技能库和冻结执行器，采用温控轨迹平衡（TTB）损失和递归技能进化机制，实现自动化任务编排，在14个数据集上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理编排方法面临三大挑战：1）奖励最大化下策略崩溃；2）信用分配不透明导致梯度方差高；3）技能进化缺乏原则性训练信号，通常直接提示LLM判断而非基于可推导的信号。
AI.method: SkillFlow框架包含三个核心创新：1）温控轨迹平衡（TTB）——基于回归的流匹配损失，按奖励比例采样轨迹，保持多样化策略；2）联合学习的后向策略，提供透明的每步信用分配且零额外推理成本；3）递归技能进化机制，基于流诊断决定何时进化、创建或裁剪何种技能、识别决策间隙。
AI.result: 在14个数据集上的实验结果显示，SkillFlow在问答、数学推理、代码生成和真实世界交互决策任务上均显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SkillFlow通过流基框架有效解决了现有LLM代理编排中的策略崩溃、信用分配和技能进化问题，实现了从训练信号到自主能力增长的闭环。

Tempered Trajectory Balance (TTB): a regression-based flow-matching loss function that samples trajectories proportional to reward, preserving diverse orchestration strategies and preventing mode collapse.
A jointly learned backward policy integrated with flow objective that provides transparent per-step credit assignment for agent actions at zero additional inference cost.

Recursive skill evolution mechanism that uses flow diagnostics to determine when to evolve, what skills to create or prune, and where decision gaps exist, forming a closed loop from training signal to autonomous capability growth.

title: ChromaFlow: A Negative Ablation Study of Orchestration Overhead in Tool-Augmented Agent Evaluation
summary: Autonomous language-model agents increasingly combine planning, tool use, document processing, browsing, code execution, and verification loops. These capabilities make agent systems more useful, but they also introduce operational failure modes that are not visible from final accuracy alone. This report presents ChromaFlow, a tool-augmented autonomous reasoning framework built around planner-directed execution, specialized tool use, and telemetry-driven evaluation. We analyze ChromaFlow on GAIA 2023 Level-1 validation tasks under clean evaluation constraints. A frozen full Level-1 baseline achieved 29/53 correct answers, or 54.72%. A later recovery configuration with expanded orchestration achieved 27/53 correct answers, or 50.94%, while increasing tracebacks, timeout events, tool-failure mentions, token-line calls, and campaign-log cost estimates. Two randomized 20-task smoke evaluations produced 12/20 and 11/20 correct answers, showing that small diagnostic gains can be unstable across samples. The central result is therefore a negative ablation: more aggressive orchestration did not improve full-set performance and increased operational noise. The report argues that bounded planner escalation, deterministic extraction, evidence reconciliation, and explicit run gates should be treated as first-order requirements for reliable autonomous agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: ChromaFlow是一个基于工具增强的自主推理框架，实验表明激进的编排策略并不能提升性能，反而增加了运行噪声，因此论文提出应将有界规划器升级、确定性提取、证据协调和显式运行门控作为可靠自主智能体评估的一阶要求。
AI.motivation: 自主语言模型智能体在结合规划、工具使用、文档处理、浏览、代码执行和验证循环时，虽然功能更强，但引入了传统准确率指标无法捕捉的运营故障模式。
AI.method: 提出ChromaFlow框架，采用规划器导向执行、专业化工具使用和遥测驱动评估，在GAIA 2023 Level-1验证任务上进行对比实验分析。
AI.result: 冻结完整Level-1基线准确率54.72%，扩展开销配置反而降至50.94%，且增加了回溯、超时、工具失败等运营噪声。两个随机20任务smoke评估分别得到60%和55%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 激进编排不能提升性能，有界规划器升级、确定性提取、证据协调和显式运行门控应作为可靠自主智能体评估的一阶要求。

title: Modeling Bounded Rationality in Drug Shortage Pharmacists Using Attention-Guided Dynamic Decomposition
comment: Accepted at CogSci 2026. 6 pages plus references, 1 figure, 2 tables
summary: Hospital pharmacists make high-stakes decisions to mitigate drug shortages under uncertainty, time pressure, and patient risk. Interviews revealed that pharmacists focus attention on a small subset of drugs, limiting cognitive effort to the most urgent cases. Motivated by these findings, we formalize a bounded-rational, attention-guided decision framework that dynamically decomposes drugs into a subset for high-cost reasoning and a complementary subset for low-cost monitoring. We develop two agents: an Expert Agent that applies attention weights derived from pharmacist interviews, and a Learner Agent that adapts attention allocation over time through experience. Across simulated scenarios spanning short to long horizons, we show that attention-guided planning supports stable decision-making without complete state reasoning. These results suggest that a primary decision is not what action to take, but where to allocate cognitive effort, and that attention-guided, satisficing strategies can reduce problem complexity while maintaining stable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了医院药师在药物短缺下的决策行为，提出了一种有限理性、注意力引导的决策框架，通过两个智能体（专家智能体和学习智能体）动态分配注意力资源，在不完全状态推理下实现稳定决策。
AI.motivation: 医院药师在不确定、高时间压力且面临患者风险的情况下，需要做出高风险的药物短缺决策。访谈发现药师会将注意力集中在一小部分关键药物上，以限制认知负荷。受此启发，研究者希望形式化这种有限理性决策过程。
AI.method: 提出注意力引导的有界理性决策框架：1）将药物动态分解为高成本推理子集和低成本监控子集；2）开发专家智能体（使用药师访谈的注意力权重）和学习智能体（随时间自适应调整注意力分配）；3）在短到长周期的模拟场景中验证。
AI.result: 注意力引导的规划方法能够在无需完全状态推理的情况下支持稳定决策，在短到长周期的模拟场景中均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 核心决策不是采取什么行动，而是将认知努力分配到哪里；注意力引导的满意策略可以在降低问题复杂度的同时保持稳定性能。
idea_en: A bounded-rational attention-guided decision framework for drug shortage management that dynamically decomposes drugs into a high-cost reasoning subset and a low-cost monitoring subset.
An Expert Agent that applies attention weights derived from pharmacist interviews to prioritize drugs under shortage conditions.
A Learner Agent that adaptively adjusts attention allocation over time through experience in drug shortage scenarios.
An attention-guided satisficing planning method that maintains stable decision performance without requiring complete state reasoning under uncertainty.

title: ClawForge: Generating Executable Interactive Benchmarks for Command-Line Agents
summary: Interactive agent benchmarks face a tension between scalable construction and realistic workflow evaluation. Hand-authored tasks are expensive to extend and revise, while static prompt evaluation misses failures that only appear when agents operate over persistent state. Existing interactive benchmarks have advanced agent evaluation significantly, but most initialize tasks from clean state and do not systematically test how agents handle pre-existing partial, stale, or conflicting artifacts. We present \textbf{ClawForge}, a generator-backed benchmark framework for executable command-line workflows under state conflict. The framework compiles scenario templates, grounded slots, initialized state, reference trajectories, and validators into reproducible task specifications, and evaluates agents step by step over persistent workflow surfaces using normalized end state and observable side effects rather than exact trajectory matching. We instantiate this framework as the ClawForge-Bench (17 scenarios, 6 ability categories). Results across seven frontier models show that the best model reaches only 45.3% strict accuracy, wrong-state replacement remains below 17\% for all models, and the widest model separation (17% to 90%) is driven by whether agents inspect existing state before acting. Partial-credit and step-efficiency analyses further reveal that many failures are near-miss closures rather than early breakdowns, and that models exhibit qualitatively different failure styles under state conflict.

AI.tldr: ClawForge是一个基于生成器的基准测试框架，用于评估命令行代理在处理存在状态冲突（如部分、过时或冲突的工件）的工作流时的表现。实验表明，即使最好的模型也仅达到45.3%的严格准确率，且代理在行动前是否检查现有状态是表现差异的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式代理基准测试存在两难：手工构建任务成本高且难以扩展，静态提示评估无法捕捉代理在持久状态上操作时出现的失败。现有基准大多从干净状态初始化任务，未系统测试代理处理预先存在的部分、过时或冲突工件的能力。
AI.method: 提出ClawForge框架，通过编译器将场景模板、接地槽位、初始化状态、参考轨迹和验证器组合成可重复的任务规范，并基于归一化的最终状态和可观察的副作用（而非精确轨迹匹配）对代理进行逐步评估。
AI.result: 在17个场景、6个能力类别上测试7个前沿模型，最佳模型严格准确率仅45.3%，错误状态替换率低于17%，模型间最大差异（17%至90%）由代理是否在行动前检查现有状态决定。部分信用和步骤效率分析显示许多失败是接近成功而非早期崩溃。
AI.conclusion: ClawForge有效评估了代理在状态冲突下的表现，揭示了代理在行动前检查现有状态的重要性，并展示了不同模型在状态冲突下具有不同失败风格。
idea_en: A generator-backed benchmark framework for executable command-line workflows that compiles scenario templates, grounded slots, initialized state, reference trajectories, and validators into reproducible task specifications.
An evaluation method that normalizes end state and observable side effects rather than exact trajectory matching for step-by-step agent evaluation over persistent workflow surfaces.
A method for testing agent behavior under state conflict by initializing tasks with pre-existing partial, stale, or conflicting artifacts rather than clean state.
A system for classifying agent failure styles under state conflict through partial-credit and step-efficiency analysis revealing qualitatively different failure patterns.
A benchmark framework with 17 scenarios across 6 ability categories specifically designed to measure whether agents inspect existing state before acting.

title: Distribution-Aware Algorithm Design with LLM Agents
summary:
We study learning when the learned object is executable solver code rather than a predictor. In this setting, correctness is not enough: two solvers may both return valid solutions on the deployment distribution while differing substantially in runtime. Given samples from an unknown task distribution, the learner returns code evaluated on fresh instances by both solution quality and execution time. Our central abstraction is a \emph{solver hint}: reusable structure inferred from samples and compiled into specialized solver code. We prove that the empirically fastest sample-consistent solver from a fixed library generalizes in both correctness and runtime, and that statistically identifiable hints can be recovered and compiled from polynomially many samples.
  Empirically, we instantiate the framework with LLM code agents on \(21\) structured combinatorial-optimization target distributions across seven problem classes. The synthesized solvers reach mean normalized quality \(0.971\), improve by \(+0.224\) over the average heuristic pool and by \(+0.098\) over the highest-quality heuristic, and are \(336.9\times\), \(342.8\times\), and \(16.1\times\) faster than the quality-best heuristic, Gurobi, and the selected time-limited exact backend, respectively. On released PACE 2025 Dominating Set private instances, the synthesized solver is valid on all \(100\) graphs and runs about two orders of magnitude faster than top competition solvers, with a moderate quality gap. Inspection shows that many gains come from changing the computational scale: replacing ambient exponential search or general-purpose optimization with compiled distribution-specific computation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何从样本中学习生成可执行的求解器代码（而非预测器），重点关注求解质量与运行时间。核心概念是“求解器提示”（solver hint）：从样本中推断出的可重用结构，编译为专用求解器代码。理论证明固定库中经验最快的一致性求解器在正确性和运行时间上均能泛化。实验在21个组合优化目标分布上，LLM代码智能体合成的求解器达到平均归一化质量0.971，速度比最优质量启发式快336.9倍，比Gurobi快342.8倍。在PACE 2025 Dominating Set私有实例上，合成求解器对所有100个图有效，运行速度比顶级竞赛求解器快约两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习学习预测器，但许多实际应用需要可执行的求解器代码，且仅保证正确性不够——两个求解器可能都返回有效解，但运行时间差异巨大。本文旨在学习既正确又高效的求解器代码。
AI.method: 提出“求解器提示”（solver hint）抽象概念，即从样本中推断的可重用结构，编译为专用求解器代码。理论证明固定库中经验最快的一致性求解器能在正确性和运行时间上泛化。实证中使用LLM代码智能体在21个组合优化分布上合成求解器。
AI.result: 合成求解器平均归一化质量0.971；比平均启发式池提高0.224，比最高质量启发式提高0.098；速度比质量最优启发式快336.9倍，比Gurobi快342.8倍，比限时精确后端快16.1倍。在PACE 2025 Dominating Set上100个图全部有效，速度比顶级竞赛求解器快约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 许多性能提升源于改变计算规模：将指数级搜索或通用优化替换为编译后的分布专用计算。该方法在正确性和效率上均实现了有效泛化。
idea_en: A method for learning executable solver code from samples of an unknown task distribution, where the learned solver is evaluated on both solution quality and execution time on new instances.
A solver hint abstraction that captures reusable structure inferred from samples, which is then compiled into specialized solver code for improved runtime.
A theoretical framework proving that the empirically fastest sample-consistent solver from a fixed library generalizes in both correctness and runtime.
A method for recovering and compiling statistically identifiable hints from polynomially many samples.
An LLM-based code agent framework that synthesizes specialized solvers for structured combinatorial optimization problems, achieving orders-of-magnitude speedup over general-purpose solvers.
A technique for replacing ambient exponential search or general-purpose optimization with compiled distribution-specific computation to change the computational scale.

一种求解器提示（solver hint）抽象，捕获从样本中推断出的可重用结构，编译为专用求解器代码以提升运行效率。

title: Agentic Systems as Boosting Weak Reasoning Models
summary: Can a committee of weak reasoning-model calls reach the performance of much stronger models? We study verifier-backed committee search as inference-time boosting for reasoning language models. The mechanism is not simply that ``more agents help'': samples expose latent correct solutions, while critics and comparators must recover them without access to the hidden verifier. We formalize this view by separating proposal coverage, local identifiability, progress, and diversity. We prove that coverage can be amplified by repeated sampling, but cannot by itself create useful critics or comparators; reliable amplification requires an additional local soundness signal, such as execution, proof checking, type checking, tests, or constraint solving. We give rank-based bounds showing when local selection errors compose into reliable trajectories, and characterize the proposer-side ceiling: oracle best-of-\(k\) converges only to the mass of task slices on which the proposal system assigns nonzero useful probability. Empirically, on SWE-bench Verified, a single \texttt{GPT-5.4 nano} proposal solves \(67.0\%\) of tasks. Using the same nano model, our critic--comparator orchestration reaches \(76.4\%\) with \(k=8\) proposals, matching the standalone performance of \texttt{Gemini 3 Pro} and \texttt{Claude Opus 4.5} Thinking and approaching the \(79.0\%\) oracle best-of-\(8\) upper bound. Thus, many correct patches are already present in weak-model proposal pools; the main challenge is selecting them. The remaining failures are mostly proposal-coverage failures, indicating shared blind spots that stronger selection alone cannot close.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何使用验证器支持的委员会搜索（verifier-backed committee search）作为推理语言模型的推理时增强技术，通过组合多个弱推理模型（如GPT-5.4 nano）的提议、批评者和比较者，达到与更强模型（如Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus 4.5 Thinking）相当的性能，揭示了正确解决方案已存在于弱模型提议池中，主要挑战在于如何筛选它们。
AI.motivation: 探索弱推理模型组成的委员会能否达到更强模型的性能水平，并形式化分析其理论边界与条件。
AI.method: 提出验证器支持的委员会搜索框架，分离提议覆盖（proposal coverage）、局部可识别性（local identifiability）、进度（progress）和多样性（diversity）。通过重复采样放大覆盖，利用局部健全性信号（如执行、证明检查、类型检查、测试、约束求解）构建批评者和比较者。给出基于秩的界，分析局部选择误差如何组合成可靠轨迹。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，单GPT-5.4 nano提议解决67.0%任务；使用相同nano模型通过批评-比较编排，k=8提议时达到76.4%，匹配Gemini 3 Pro和Claude Opus 4.5 Thinking的独立性能，接近79.0%的oracle best-of-8上限。
AI.conclusion: 许多正确补丁已存在于弱模型提议池中，主要挑战是选择它们；剩余失败主要是提议覆盖失败，表明存在共享盲点，仅靠更强的选择无法解决。
idea_en: Verifier-backed committee search method for inference-time boosting of reasoning language models, using multiple weak models as proposers, critics and comparators to match strong model performance.
Separation framework for proposal coverage, local identifiability, progress, and diversity for formal analysis of committee-based reasoning amplification.
Rank-based bounds analysis for composing local selection errors into reliable decision trajectories in model committees.

Method for amplifying proposal coverage through repeated sampling while using local soundness signals (execution, proof checking, type checking, tests, constraint solving) for critic/comparator construction.
Critic-comparator orchestration system that enables weak model committees to reach oracle best-of-k upper bound performance in software engineering task selection.

title: Unsteady Metrics and Benchmarking Cultures of AI Model Builders
summary: The primary way to establish and compare competencies in foundation and generative AI models has shifted from peer-reviewed literature to press releases and company blog posts, where model builders highlight results on selected benchmarks. These artifacts now largely define the state of the art for researchers and the public. Despite their prominence, which benchmarks model builders choose to highlight, and what they communicate through this selection, is underexamined. To investigate, we introduce and open-source Benchmarking-Cultures-25, a dataset of 231 benchmarks highlighted across 139 model releases in 2025 from 11 major AI builders, alongside an interactive tool to explore the data. Our analysis reveals a fragmented evaluation landscape with limited cross-model comparability: 63.2% of highlighted benchmarks are used by a single builder, and 38.5% appear in just one release. Few achieve widespread use (e.g., GPQA Diamond, LiveCodeBench, AIME 2025). Moreover, benchmarks are attributed different competencies by different builders, depending on their narrative. To disentangle these conflicting presentations, we develop a unified taxonomy mapping diverging terminology to a shared framework of measured signals based on what benchmark authors claim to measure. "General knowledge application" is the second most popular, yet vaguely defined, category. Qualitative analysis shows many such benchmarks deemphasize construct validity, instead framing results as indicators of progress toward AGI. Their authors claim to measure knowledge or reasoning broadly, yet mostly evaluate STEM subjects (especially math). We argue that highlighted benchmarks function less as standardized measurement tools and more as flexible narrative devices prioritizing market positioning over scientific evaluation. Data: https://hf.co/datasets/matybohacek/benchmarking-cultures-25; tool: https://bench-cultures.net.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建Benchmarking-Cultures-25数据集，分析了2025年11家主要AI厂商在139次模型发布中强调的231个基准测试，发现评测格局碎片化、缺乏跨模型可比性，且基准测试更多被用作市场叙事工具而非科学评估手段。
AI.motivation: 目前评估基础模型和生成式AI模型能力的主要方式已从同行评审文献转向新闻稿和博客文章，但模型构建者选择强调哪些基准测试、通过这些选择传达什么信息，尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 1. 构建并开源Benchmarking-Cultures-25数据集，包含2025年11家AI厂商139次模型发布中强调的231个基准测试；2. 开发交互式数据探索工具；3. 建立统一分类法，将不同术语映射到共享的测量信号框架；4. 进行定性分析。
AI.result: 63.2%的强调基准测试仅被单一构建者使用，38.5%仅出现在一次发布中；不同构建者将不同能力归因于相同的基准测试；"通用知识应用"是第二大流行但定义模糊的类别；许多基准测试忽视构念效度，将结果描述为AGI进展指标，但实际上主要评估STEM学科。
AI.conclusion: 被强调的基准测试更多是作为灵活叙事工具，优先服务于市场定位而非科学评估。

title: The Evaluation Trap: Benchmark Design as Theoretical Commitment
summary: Every AI benchmark operationalizes theoretical assumptions about the capability it claims to assess. When assumptions function as unexamined commitments, benchmarks stabilize the dominant paradigm by narrowing what counts as progress. Over time, narrow evaluation reorganizes capability concepts: architectures and definitions are selected for benchmark legibility until evaluation ceases to track an independent object and instead produces a version of the target defined by its own operational assumptions. The result is a trap: evaluation frameworks treat self-reinforcing assessments as valid, both creating and obscuring structural limits on what the current paradigm can accomplish. We introduce Epistematics, a methodology for deriving evaluation criteria directly from technical capability claims and auditing whether proposed benchmarks can discriminate the claimed capability from proxy behaviors. The contribution is meta-evaluative: an audit procedure, a failure mode taxonomy, and benchmark-design criteria for evaluating capability-evaluation coherence. We demonstrate the procedure through a worked audit of Dupoux et al. (2026), a proposal that revises the dominant paradigm's theoretical assumptions at the architectural level while reproducing them in its evaluation criteria, thereby entrenching the constraint it seeks to overcome in a form the evaluation cannot detect.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种元评估方法论（Epistematics），用于审计AI基准测试与能力声明之间的理论一致性，揭示基准测试如何通过自强化评估陷阱重塑能力概念并阻碍范式突破。
AI.motivation: 当前AI基准测试将理论假设固化为不言自明的承诺，导致评估标准窄化并产生自我确证的陷阱——基准不再追踪独立的客观能力，而是通过操作化假设生产出目标能力的某种版本，从而掩盖了当前范式的结构性局限。
AI.method: 提出Epistematics方法论：直接从技术能力声明推导评估标准，审计提议的基准能否区分目标能力与代理行为（proxy behaviors）。包含审计程序、故障模式分类法和基准设计准则，并通过Dupoux等人(2026)的案例展示审计过程。
AI.result: 通过Dupoux等人案例证明：即使架构层面试图修订范式假设，若评估标准仍沿用旧范式的隐含预设，则会以不可检测的形式固化原本要突破的约束，形成更深层的评估陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 基准评估必须进行元评估层面的自我审查，否则进步将沦为对评估框架的适应而非对真实能力的提升。Epistematics提供了一种打破自强化循环的系统性审计方法。
idea_en: A meta-evaluative audit methodology (Epistematics) for deriving evaluation criteria directly from technical capability claims and auditing whether proposed benchmarks can discriminate the claimed capability from proxy behaviors.
A failure mode taxonomy categorizing how benchmarks can entrain self-reinforcing assessments that both create and obscure structural limits on what a paradigm can accomplish.
Benchmark-design criteria for evaluating capability-evaluation coherence, preventing evaluation frameworks from treating self-reinforcing assessments as valid.
A worked audit procedure demonstrating that revising theoretical assumptions at the architectural level while reproducing them in evaluation criteria creates undetectable evaluation traps.
idea_ch: 一种元评估审计方法论（Epistematics），直接从技术能力声明推导评估标准，审计提议的基准能否区分目标能力与代理行为（proxy behaviors）。
一种故障模式分类法，系统归类基准测试如何产生自强化评估，同时制造并掩盖当前范式的结构性局限。

title: Grounded Continuation: A Linear-Time Runtime Verifier for LLM Conversations
summary: In long conversations, an LLM can produce a next utterance that sounds plausible but rests on premises the conversation has already abandoned. Context-manipulation attacks against deployed agents now actively exploit this gap. We close it with a runtime verifier that maintains an explicit dependency graph: an LLM classifies each turn into one of 8 update operations drawn from four formalisms (dynamic epistemic logic, abductive reasoning, awareness logic, argumentation), and a symbolic engine records which claims depend on which evidence. Checking whether a continuation is supported reduces to a graph walk; retraction propagates through the same graph to flag exactly the conclusions that lose support, with linear per-turn cost and a formal conflict-free guarantee. On LongMemEval-KU oracle (n=78), the verifier reaches 89.7% accuracy vs. 88.5% for the LLM-only baseline (+1.3pp) and 87.2% for a transcript-RAG baseline matched on retrieval budget (+2.6pp); wins among disagreements are correct abstentions where the baseline confabulates. On LoCoMo's 60 official QA items the verifier is competitive with retrieval-augmented baselines. Beyond external benchmarks, we construct two multi-agent scenarios and a 50-item grounding test: on the 15-item stale-premise subset, the verifier reaches 100% accuracy vs. 93.3% (+6.7pp). These instantiate a soundness-faithfulness decomposition: the structural check is sound by construction, and per-deployment LLM extraction faithfulness is the empirical question we measure across four LLM families. The retraction check plateaus at microseconds while history-replay grows linearly with conversation length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种运行时验证器，通过显式依赖图维护对话中的证据-结论关系，利用8种更新操作（来自动态认知逻辑、溯因推理、意识逻辑、论证理论）检测并标记LLM在长对话中基于已撤回前提生成的不可靠回复，实现线性时间复杂度的冲突自由保障。
AI.motivation: LLM在长对话中可能产生表面合理但基于已废弃前提的回复，现有上下文操纵攻击正利用这一漏洞，亟需一种形式化验证机制来确保对话的语义一致性。
AI.method: 1）设计8种更新操作（来自动态认知逻辑、溯因推理、意识逻辑、论证理论）；2）LLM将每轮对话分类为某操作，符号引擎构建依赖图；3）检查新回复是否被图支持（图遍历），撤回时沿图传播标记失去支持的结论。
AI.result: LongMemEval-KU oracle上89.7%准确率（vs LLM-only 88.5%）；LoCoMo上与检索增强基线竞争；15项过时前提子集上100%准确率（vs 93.3%）；撤回检查微秒级，历史回放随对话长度线性增长。
AI.conclusion: 验证器实现了"可靠性-保真度"分解：结构检查天生可靠，LLM提取保真度是可测量的实证问题，为长对话LLM的安全性提供了形式化保障。
idea_en: A runtime verifier for LLM conversations that maintains an explicit dependency graph using 8 update operations drawn from dynamic epistemic logic, abductive reasoning, awareness logic, and argumentation formalisms
A symbolic engine that records which claims depend on which evidence, with support checking reduced to a graph walk and retraction propagation through the same graph
A soundness-faithfulness decomposition approach where structural checks are sound by construction and per-deployment LLM extraction faithfulness is empirically measurable
Linear per-turn cost verification with formal conflict-free guarantee for long conversation consistency
idea_ch: 基于动态认知逻辑、溯因推理、意识逻辑和论证理论四种形式化的8种更新操作，构建LLM对话运行时验证器的显式依赖图
