title: SimPersona: Learning Discrete Buyer Personas from Raw Clickstreams for Grounded E-Commerce Agents
summary: LLM-based web agents can navigate live storefronts, yet they often collapse to a single "average buyer" policy, failing to capture the heterogeneous and distributional nature of real buyer populations. Existing personalization methods rely on hand-crafted prompt-based personas that are brittle, difficult to scale, context-inefficient, and unable to faithfully represent population-level behavior. We introduce SimPersona, a novel framework that learns discrete buyer types from historical traffic and exposes them to LLM-based web agents as compact persona tokens. Given raw clickstreams, a behavior-aware VQ-VAE induces a discrete buyer-type space that captures the statistical structure of real buyer behavior and merchant-specific buyer population distributions. To provide behavior-specific guidance to LLM-based web agents, SimPersona maps each learned buyer type to a dedicated persona token in the LLM agent vocabulary and fine-tunes the agent with these tokens on real browsing traces. At inference, each synthetic buyer is assigned to a learned buyer type with a single encoder forward pass, requiring no retraining or store-specific prompt engineering. For population-level simulation, SimPersona samples buyer types from each merchant's empirical distribution over the learned VQ-VAE codebook and instantiates agents with the corresponding persona tokens, preserving merchant-specific buyer population distributions. Evaluated on $8.37$M buyers across $42$ held-out live storefronts, SimPersona achieves $78\%$ conversion-rate alignment with real buyers, exhibits interpretable behavioral variation across buyer types, and outperforms a baseline with $8\times$ more parameters on goal-oriented shopping tasks. We further release an open-source data pipeline that converts raw e-commerce event logs into buyer representations and agent-training traces.

AI.tldr: SimPersona是一个从历史流量中学习离散买家类型、并通过紧凑的persona令牌将其暴露给LLM网页代理的框架，能够真实模拟买家群体的异质性和分布特征，在42个真实线上店铺中实现78%的转化率对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的网页代理在模拟买家行为时会坍缩为单一"平均买家"策略，无法捕捉真实买家群体的异质性和分布特征。现有的个性化方法依赖于手工构建的基于提示的persona，这些方法脆弱、难以扩展、上下文效率低，且无法忠实代表群体层面的行为。
AI.method: SimPersona框架包括：(1) 使用行为感知的VQ-VAE从原始点击流中学习离散的买家类型空间；(2) 将每个学习到的买家类型映射到LLM代理词汇表中的专用persona令牌，并在真实浏览轨迹上对代理进行微调；(3) 推理时通过单次编码器前向传播将合成买家分配到学习到的买家类型；(4) 对于群体级模拟，从每个商家的经验分布中采样买家类型并实例化相应的persona令牌代理。
AI.result: 在42个真实线上店铺中对837万买家进行评估，SimPersona实现了78%的转化率对齐，展现了跨买家类型的可解释行为变异，在目标导向购物任务上优于参数规模大8倍的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: SimPersona能够有效捕捉真实买家行为的异质性和分布特征，通过离散买家类型和persona令牌实现可扩展、无需重新训练或特定商店提示工程的个性化网页代理模拟。
idea_en: A method for learning discrete buyer types from historical clickstream data using a behavior-aware VQ-VAE, where the discrete codebook captures statistical structures of real buyer behavior without requiring manual categorization.
System architecture that maps learned discrete buyer types to dedicated persona tokens in an LLM agent's vocabulary, enabling behavior-specific guidance through fine-tuning on real browsing traces.

One-shot buyer type assignment mechanism that performs a single encoder forward pass at inference time to assign synthetic buyers to learned types, eliminating the need for retraining or store-specific prompt engineering.

Population-level simulation method that samples buyer types from each merchant's empirical distribution over a learned VQ-VAE codebook, preserving merchant-specific buyer population distributions in agent-based simulations.
An open-source data pipeline that converts raw e-commerce event logs into structured buyer representations and agent-training traces, enabling reproducible research on personalized web agents.
Behavior-aware VQ-VAE training approach that induces a discrete buyer-type space from raw clickstreams, capturing both individual behavior patterns and merchant-specific population distributions.
idea_ch: 一种使用行为感知VQ-VAE从历史点击流数据中学习离散买家类型的方法，其离散码本能够捕捉真实买家行为的统计结构，无需人工分类。
将学习到的离散买家类型映射到LLM代理词汇表中的专用persona令牌的系统架构，通过在真实浏览轨迹上微调实现行为特定的代理引导。

将原始电商事件日志转换为结构化买家表示和代理训练轨迹的开源数据流水线，支持可重复的个性化网页代理研究。

title: ASH: Agents that Self-Hone via Embodied Learning
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks remain a fundamental challenge in AI, as current methods rely on hand-engineered rewards or action-labeled demonstrations, neither of which scales. We introduce ASH, an agentic system that learns an embodied policy from unlabeled, noisy internet video, without reward shaping or expert annotation. ASH follows a self-improvement loop; when it gets stuck, ASH learns an Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM) from its own trajectories, and uses its IDM to extract supervision from relevant internet video. ASH uses unsupervised learning to identify key moments from large-scale internet video and retains them as long-term memory -- allowing it to tackle long-horizon problems. We evaluate ASH on two complementary environments demanding multi-hour planning: Pokemon Emerald, a turn-based RPG, and The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap, a real-time action-adventure game. In both games, behavioral cloning, retrieval-augmented and zero-shot foundation-model baselines plateau, while ASH sustains progression across our 8-hour evaluation. ASH reaches an average of $11.2/12$ milestones in Pokemon Emerald and $9.9/12$ in Legend of Zelda, while the strongest baseline gets stuck in both environments at an average of $6.5/12$ and $6.0/12$ milestones, respectively. We demonstrate that self-improving agents are a scalable recipe for long-horizon embodied learning.

AI.tldr: ASH是一种无需奖励工程或专家标注，通过从无标签、有噪声的互联网视频中自我改进来学习长周期具身策略的智能体系统，在宝可梦翡翠和塞尔达缩小帽两个游戏中显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 长周期具身任务在AI中仍是根本性挑战，现有方法依赖手工设计的奖励或动作标注的示范数据，难以规模化扩展。
AI.method: ASH采用自我改进循环：当智能体卡住时，从自身轨迹中学习逆向动力学模型（IDM），并用IDM从相关互联网视频中提取监督信号；同时使用无监督学习从大规模互联网视频中识别关键时刻并存储为长期记忆。
AI.result: 在宝可梦翡翠中达到平均11.2/12个里程碑，塞尔达缩小帽中达到9.9/12个里程碑，而最强基线在两个环境中分别仅达到6.5/12和6.0/12个里程碑。
AI.conclusion: 自我改进智能体是长周期具身学习的一种可规模化方案。
idea_en: Self-improvement loop for embodied policy learning: a system that learns Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM) from its own failure trajectories and uses the IDM to extract supervision signals from unlabeled internet videos
Unsupervised key-moment identification from large-scale internet video for long-term memory retention in long-horizon tasks
Cross-domain video supervision transfer: using IDM learned from agent's own trajectories to decode action information from diverse internet videos
Self-supervised milestone tracking via unsupervised learning from noisy internet video without reward shaping or expert annotation

title: MetaAgent-X : Breaking the Ceiling of Automatic Multi-Agent Systems via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
summary: Automatic multi-agent systems aim to instantiate agent workflows without relying on manually designed or fixed orchestration. However, existing automatic MAS approaches remain only partially adaptive: they either perform training-free test-time search or optimize the meta-level designer while keeping downstream execution agents frozen, which creating a frozen-executor ceiling and leaving the end-to-end training of self-designing and self-executing agentic models unexplored. To address this, we introduce MetaAgent-X, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that jointly optimizes automatic MAS design and execution. MetaAgent-X enables script-based MAS generation, execution rollout collection, and credit assignment for both designer and executor trajectories. To support stable and scalable optimization, we propose Executor Designer Hierarchical Rollout and Stagewise Co-evolution to improve training stability and expose the dynamics of designer-executor co-evolution. MetaAgent-X consistently outperforms existing automatic MAS baselines, achieving up to 21.7% gains. Comprehensive ablations show that both designer and executor improve throughout training, and that effective automatic MAS learning follows a stagewise co-evolution process. These results establish end-to-end trainable automatic MAS as a practical paradigm for building self-designing and self-executing agentic models.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaAgent-X，一个端到端强化学习框架，联合优化自动多智能体系统的设计与执行，通过脚本生成、执行轨迹收集和信用分配，实现自我设计与自我执行。
AI.motivation: 现有自动MAS方法仅部分自适应，要么进行无训练测试时搜索，要么优化元级设计者而冻结执行智能体，存在"冻结执行器天花板"问题，端到端训练自设计和自执行智能体模型尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出MetaAgent-X框架：(1) 基于脚本的MAS生成；(2) 执行轨迹收集；(3) 设计者和执行器轨迹的信用分配；(4) 执行器-设计者分层推演（ED-HR）和分阶段协同进化（SWCE）以提升训练稳定性和可扩展性。
AI.result: MetaAgent-X持续优于现有自动MAS基线，最高提升21.7%。消融实验表明设计者和执行器在训练过程中均持续改进，有效自动MAS学习遵循分阶段协同进化过程。
AI.conclusion: 端到端可训练自动MAS是构建自设计和自执行智能体模型的可行范式。
idea_en: End-to-end reinforcement learning framework for joint optimization of multi-agent system design and execution without manual orchestration
Script-based MAS automatic generation combined with execution rollout collection for self-designing agent workflows
Executor-Designer Hierarchical Rollout (ED-HR) mechanism for stable credit assignment across designer and executor trajectories
Stagewise Co-evolution (SWCE) training strategy to improve stability and expose dynamics of designer-executor co-evolution
Hierarchical credit assignment method that jointly optimizes both meta-level designer and downstream execution agents in an end-to-end manner
idea_ch: 一种端到端强化学习框架，联合优化多智能体系统的自动设计与执行，无需手动编排
基于脚本的MAS自动生成与执行轨迹收集相结合的自我设计智能体工作流方法

title: GenCircuit-RL: Reinforcement Learning from Hierarchical Verification for Genetic Circuit Design
summary: Genetic circuit design remains a laborious, expert-driven process despite decades of progress in synthetic biology. We study this problem through code generation: models produce Python code in pysbol3 to construct genetic circuits in the Synthetic Biology Open Language (SBOL), a formal representation that supports automated verification. We introduce GenCircuit-RL, a reinforcement learning framework built around hierarchical verification rewards that decompose correctness into five levels, from code execution to task-specific topological checks, and a four-stage curriculum that shifts optimization pressure from code generation to functional reasoning. We also introduce SynBio-Reason, a benchmark of 4,753 circuits spanning six canonical circuit types and nine tasks from code repair to de novo design, with held-out biological parts for out-of-distribution evaluation. Hierarchical verification improves task success on functional reasoning tasks by 14 to 16 percentage points over binary rewards, and curriculum learning is required for strong design performance. The resulting models generate topologically correct circuits, generalize to novel biological parts, and rediscover canonical designs from the synthetic biology literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GenCircuit-RL，一个基于层级验证奖励和课程学习的强化学习框架，用于通过代码生成自动化设计遗传电路。同时引入SynBio-Reason基准，包含4,753个电路和六类九种任务。层级验证奖励将正确性分解为五个层级，课程学习分四个阶段，在功能推理任务上比二元奖励提升14-16个百分点，模型可生成拓扑正确的电路并泛化至新生物元件。
AI.motivation: 遗传电路设计仍然是劳动密集型的专家驱动过程，尽管合成生物学已发展数十年。现有方法缺乏自动化验证和泛化能力，需要更智能的自动化设计方法。
AI.method: 提出GenCircuit-RL强化学习框架：(1) 层级验证奖励(Hierarchical Verification Rewards)，将正确性分解为五个层级（代码执行、语法正确性、拓扑检查等）；(2) 四阶段课程学习(Curriculum Learning)，逐步从代码生成过渡到功能推理；同时构建SynBio-Reason基准数据集，包含4,753个电路和九种任务。
AI.result: 层级验证奖励在功能推理任务上比二元奖励提升14-16个百分点；课程学习对强设计性能不可或缺；模型能生成拓扑正确的电路，泛化到新生物元件，并重新发现文献中的经典设计。
AI.conclusion: 层级验证奖励与课程学习的结合显著提升了遗传电路代码生成的质量和泛化能力，为合成生物学的自动化设计提供了新范式。
idea_en: A hierarchical verification reward system for genetic circuit code generation that decomposes correctness into five levels (code execution, syntactic correctness, topological verification, etc.), enabling fine-grained reinforcement learning signal for synthetic biology design.

A four-stage curriculum learning framework for training code generation models in genetic circuit design, progressively shifting optimization pressure from basic code generation to complex functional reasoning.

A benchmark dataset (SynBio-Reason) containing 4,753 genetic circuits across six canonical circuit types and nine tasks including code repair and de novo design, with held-out biological parts for out-of-distribution evaluation.
A reinforcement learning method (GenCircuit-RL) that generates pysbol3 Python code to construct genetic circuits in SBOL formal representation, supporting automated verification of circuit designs.

A method for rediscovering canonical genetic circuit designs from synthetic biology literature through RL-trained code generation models, demonstrating the ability to generalize to novel biological parts.
idea_ch: 一种用于遗传电路代码生成的层级验证奖励系统，将正确性分解为五个层级（代码执行、语法正确性、拓扑验证等），为合成生物学设计提供细粒度的强化学习信号。

title: Fusion-fission forecasts when AI will shift to undesirable behavior
summary: The key problem facing ChatGPT-like AI's use across society is that its behavior can shift, unnoticed, from desirable to undesirable -- encouraging self-harm, extremist acts, financial losses, or costly medical and military mistakes -- and no one can yet predict when. Shifts persist in even the newest AI models despite remarkable progress in AI modeling, post-training alignment and safeguards. Here we show that a vector generalization of fusion-fission group dynamics observed in living and active-matter systems drives -- and can forecast -- future shifts in the AI's behavior. The shift condition, which is also derivable mathematically, results from group-level competition between the conversation-so-far (C) and the desirable (B) and undesirable (D) basin dynamics which can be estimated in advance for a given application. It is neither model-specific nor driven by stochastic sampling. We validate it across six independent tests, including: 90 percent correct across seven AI models spanning two orders of magnitude in parameter count (124M-12B); production-scale persistence across ten frontier chatbots; and a priori time-stamped prediction eleven months before the Stanford 'Delusional Spirals' corpus appeared, and independently confirmed by that corpus of 207,443 human-AI exchanges. Because it sits architecturally below the current safety stack, the same formula provides a real-time warning signal that current alignment does not supply, portable across current and future ChatGPT-like AI architectures and instantiable in application domains where competing response classes can be defined.

AI.tldr: 本文发现一种向量化的聚变-裂变群体动力学机制可以驱动并预测ChatGPT类AI的行为偏移（从合意行为转向不合意行为），该机制不依赖具体模型或随机采样，并在多个大规模测试中验证了其预测能力。
AI.motivation: ChatGPT类AI在实际应用中存在行为不可预测地从合意转向不合意（如鼓励自残、极端行为、金融损失、医疗军事错误等）的关键问题，现有对齐技术和安全措施无法提前预警这种偏移。
AI.method: 提出一种基于向量广义化的聚变-裂变群体动力学模型，通过分析对话上下文(C)、合意盆地(B)和不合意盆地(D)之间的组间竞争来预测行为偏移条件。该条件可通过数学推导获得，且可在应用前预先估计。
AI.result: 在6项独立测试中验证：7个AI模型（参数124M-12B，跨度两个数量级）上达到90%正确率；10个前沿聊天机器人上展示生产级持续性；提前11个月先验时间戳预测了Stanford 'Delusional Spirals'语料库的出现，并被该语料库（207,443条人机对话）独立证实。
AI.conclusion: 该公式位于当前安全栈架构之下，可作为现有对齐方法无法提供的实时预警信号，可跨当前及未来的ChatGPT类AI架构移植，并可在可定义竞争响应类的应用领域中实例化。
idea_en: A method for predicting AI behavior shifts using vectorized fusion-fission group dynamics that models competition between conversation context (C), desirable basin (B), and undesirable basin (D).
A real-time warning system for ChatGPT-like AI that operates below the current safety stack and provides early signals of behavioral shifts before they become harmful.
A pre-deployment estimation technique for AI behavior stability that computes shift conditions based on group-level competition dynamics, independent of model architecture or stochastic sampling.
An architecture-agnostic safety monitoring method for large language models that forecasts undesirable behavior emergence across different model scales (from 124M to 12B parameters).
A time-stamped prediction system for AI delusional spirals and harmful behavior patterns, validated against real-world 207,443 human-AI exchange corpus 11 months in advance.

title: Good to Go: The LOOP Skill Engine That Hits 99% Success and Slashes Token Usage by 99% via One-Shot Recording and Deterministic Replay
summary: Deploying AI agents for repetitive periodic tasks exposes a critical tension: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer unmatched flexibility in tool orchestration, yet their inherent stochasticity causes unpredictable failures, and repeated invocations incur prohibitive token costs. We present the LOOP SKILL ENGINE, a system that achieves a combined 99% success rate and 99% token reduction for periodic agent tasks through a one-shot recording, deterministic replay paradigm. On its first run, the agent executes the task with full LLM reasoning while the system transparently intercepts and records the complete tool-call trajectory. A greedy length-descending template extraction algorithm then converts this recording into a parameterized, branch-free Loop Skill -- a deterministic execution plan that captures the task's functional intent while parameterizing time-dependent and result-dependent variables. All subsequent executions bypass the LLM entirely: the engine resolves template variables against real-time values and replays the tool sequence deterministically. We prove two theorems: (1) Replay Determinism -- the step sequence of a validated Loop Skill is invariant across all future executions; (2) Write Safety -- concurrent access to persistent configuration is serialized through reentrant locks and atomic file replacement. Across a benchmark of periodic agent tasks spanning intervals from 5 minutes to 24 hours, the Loop Skill Engine reduces monthly token consumption by 93.3%--99.98% and cuts execution latency by 8.7x while eliminating output non-determinism. A multi-layer degradation strategy guarantees that tasks never stall. We release the engine as part of the buddyMe open-source agent framework.

AI.tldr: LOOP SKILL ENGINE通过"一次性录制+确定性重放"范式，将LLM代理的周期性任务成功率提升至99%的同时实现99%的代币成本缩减，通过参数化无分支执行计划完全规避了LLM推理的随机性和高昂成本。
AI.motivation: LLM在周期性重复任务中存在随机性导致不可预测失败、重复调用产生高昂token成本的核心矛盾，亟需一种兼顾LLM灵活性与确定性执行效率的方案。
AI.method: 系统在首次执行时利用LLM完整推理完成任务，透明拦截并记录完整工具调用轨迹；通过贪心长度降序模板提取算法将轨迹转换为参数化的无分支Loop Skill（确定性执行计划）；后续执行完全绕过LLM，仅解析模板变量并确定性重放工具序列。
AI.result: 在5分钟至24小时跨度的周期性任务基准测试中，月度token消耗降低93.3%-99.98%，执行延迟减少8.7倍，消除输出非确定性，并证明了重放确定性和写入安全性两个定理。
AI.conclusion: LOOP SKILL ENGINE通过记录-重放范式有效解决了LLM在周期性任务中的随机性和成本问题，配合多层降级策略确保任务永不卡死，证明了在无需持续LLM推理的情况下保持任务可靠性的可行性。
idea_en: One-shot recording and deterministic replay paradigm for periodic LLM agent tasks, where the first execution records the complete tool-call trajectory with LLM reasoning, and all subsequent executions deterministically replay the recorded plan without invoking the LLM.

Greedy length-descending template extraction algorithm that converts recorded tool-call trajectories into parameterized, branch-free Loop Skills, capturing functional intent while parameterizing time-dependent and result-dependent variables.
Template variable resolution engine that dynamically resolves recorded template variables against real-time values during replay, enabling deterministic execution with dynamic parameter adaptation.
Replay Determinism theorem ensuring validated Loop Skill step sequence invariance across all future executions, providing formal guarantees of execution determinism.
Write Safety mechanism using reentrant locks and atomic file replacement for serializing concurrent access to persistent configuration during skill execution.
Multi-layer degradation strategy that guarantees periodic tasks never stall even when components fail, ensuring system reliability.
idea_ch: 一次性记录+确定性重放范 paradigm：首次执行利用LLM完整推理并透明记录工具调用轨迹，后续执行完全绕过LLM直接确定性重放，极大降低token成本

重放确定性定理：验证后的Loop Skill步骤序列在所有未来执行中保持不变，提供形式化的执行确定性保证

title: Hypergraph Enterprise Agentic Reasoner over Heterogeneous Business Systems
summary: Applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to heterogeneous enterprise systems is hindered by hallucinations and failures in multi-hop, n-ary reasoning. Existing paradigms (e.g., GraphRAG, NL2SQL) lack the semantic grounding and auditable execution required for these complex environments. We introduce HEAR, an enterprise agentic reasoner built on a Stratified Hypergraph Ontology. Its base Graph Layer virtualizes provenance-aware data interfaces, while the Hyperedge Layer encodes n-ary business rules and procedural protocols. Operating an evidence-driven reasoning loop, HEAR dynamically orchestrates ontology tools for structured multi-hop analysis without requiring LLM retraining. Evaluations on supply-chain tasks, including order fulfillment blockage root cause analysis (RCA), show HEAR achieves up to 94.7% accuracy. Crucially, HEAR demonstrates adaptive efficiency: utilizing procedural hyperedges to minimize token costs, while leveraging topological exploration for rigorous correctness on complex queries. By matching proprietary model performance with open-weight backbones and automating manual diagnostics, HEAR establishes a scalable, auditable foundation for enterprise intelligence.

AI.tldr: HEAR是一个基于分层超图本体的企业级智能推理系统，通过证据驱动的推理循环实现复杂供应链任务的准确、可审计推理，无需LLM重新训练，准确率达94.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM方法（如GraphRAG、NL2SQL）在异构企业系统中缺乏语义基础和执行可审计性，难以处理多跳、n-元推理任务，且存在幻觉问题。
AI.method: 构建分层超图本体，包含基础图层（虚拟化数据接口）和超边层（编码n-元业务规则），采用证据驱动推理循环动态编排本体工具进行结构化多跳分析。
AI.result: 在供应链任务（如订单履行阻塞根因分析）中达到94.7%准确率，通过程序化超边最小化token成本，利用拓扑探索保证复杂查询的正确性，用开放权重模型达到专有模型性能。
AI.conclusion: HEAR为企业智能建立了可扩展、可审计的基础，通过自动化人工诊断实现高效推理，无需LLM重新训练。
idea_en: Stratified Hypergraph Ontology with a Graph Layer for provenance-aware data interface virtualization and a Hyperedge Layer for encoding n-ary business rules and procedural protocols.
Evidence-driven reasoning loop that dynamically orchestrates ontology tools for structured multi-hop analysis without requiring LLM retraining.
Adaptive efficiency mechanism using procedural hyperedges to minimize token costs while leveraging topological exploration for rigorous correctness on complex queries.
Agentic reasoning framework that matches proprietary LLM performance using open-weight backbone models in enterprise environments.
Automated root cause analysis system for supply-chain order fulfillment blockage that achieves 94.7% accuracy.

title: Heuristic Pathologies and Further Variance Reduction via Uncertainty Propagation in the AIVAT Family of Techniques
summary:
How should an agent's performance in a multiagent environment be evaluated when there is a limited sample size or a high cost of running a trial? The AIVAT family of variance reduction techniques was proposed to address this challenge by introducing unbiased low-variance estimators of agents' expected payoffs. An important component of AIVAT is a heuristic value function that discriminates between potentially low- and high-value counterfactual histories. A notable gap in the literature is that there is little to no constraint or guideline on how the heuristic value function should be chosen or how uncertainty in its output should be handled.
  In our first contribution, we parameterize the heuristic value function to highlight AIVAT's potential vulnerabilities: a) the sample variance can be set pathologically low by directly applying gradient descent on the sample variance, and b) one can p-hack to draw a desired statistical conclusion via gradient descent/ascent on the test statistic. The main takeaway is that the heuristic value function should be fixed prior to observing the evaluation data! In our second contribution, we show how the heuristic uncertainty can be propagated to quantify the uncertainty of AIVAT estimates. It is then possible to further reduce the variance using inverse-variance weighted averaging, but AIVAT's unbiasedness guarantee may have to be sacrificed. In our experiments, we use a dataset of 10,000 poker hands to demonstrate our heuristic pathology and uncertainty results, with the latter yielding a 43.0% reduction in the number of samples (poker hands) needed to draw statistical conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体环境中AIVAT方差缩减技术的关键缺陷：启发式价值函数可能导致样本方差被人为压低或p-hacking操纵。作者提出启发式函数应在评估数据之前固定，并展示了如何传播启发式不确定性来量化AIVAT估计的不确定性，从而在扑克数据集上实现43%的样本量减少。
AI.motivation: 现有AIVAT方差缩减技术在启发式价值函数的选择上缺乏约束和指导，导致该方法存在被操纵的风险（如人为压低方差、p-hacking），且启发式函数的不确定性如何处理尚不明确。
AI.method: 1) 参数化启发式价值函数，通过梯度下降/上升展示其病理行为（方差操纵、p-hacking）；2) 提出启发式不确定性传播方法，量化AIVAT估计的不确定性；3) 采用逆方差加权平均进一步降方差（但可能牺牲无偏性）。
AI.result: 在10,000手扑克牌数据集上验证了启发式病理现象；不确定性传播方法实现了43%的样本量（扑克手数）减少，用于达成统计结论。
AI.conclusion: 启发式价值函数必须在评估数据之前固定，否则AIVAT的方差和统计显著性可被刻意操纵；传播启发式不确定性可显著提升样本效率。
idea_en: A method for preventing variance manipulation and p-hacking in AIVAT evaluation by requiring the heuristic value function to be fixed prior to observing evaluation data, with a verification protocol ensuring no gradient-based optimization is applied to the heuristic on the evaluation set.

A technique for propagating heuristic value function uncertainty to quantify the uncertainty of AIVAT estimates, enabling construction of confidence intervals for agent performance in multiagent environments.

An inverse-variance weighted averaging method applied to AIVAT estimates with propagated heuristic uncertainty, achieving up to 43% reduction in required sample size for statistical conclusions in multiagent evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种防止AIVAT评估中方差操纵和p-hacking的方法：要求启发式价值函数在观测评估数据之前固定，并建立验证协议确保评估集上未对启发式函数应用基于梯度的优化。
一种传播启发式价值函数不确定性以量化AIVAT估计不确定性的技术，能够在多智能体环境中构建智能体性能的置信区间。
一种应用于AIVAT估计的逆方差加权平均方法，结合传播的启发式不确定性，在多智能体评估中实现高达43%的所需样本量减少。

title: Agentic AI Ecosystems in Higher Education: A Perspective on AI Agents to Emerging Inclusive, Agentic Multi-Agent AI Framework for Learning, Teaching and Institutional Intelligence
summary: Integration of artificial intelligent (AI) agents in higher education is transforming teaching, learning and administrative processes. Although existing AI agents effectively support individual tasks, their implementation remains fragmented and inefficient for handling the complexity of educational institutions. This highlights a significant research gap: the lack of integrated eco-system-level agentic multi-agent AI platform capable of coordinated planning, reasoning, and adaptive decision-making across multiple educational functions. This paper presents a forward-looking perspective on agentic multi-agent AI platform in higher education, consisting interconnected autonomous, goal driven agents that support learning, teaching, and institutional operations. It addresses timely and critical questions: Can agentic AI represent the next generation of intelligent systems in tertiary education? Can they collectively support seamless coordinated operations across teaching, learning and administrative support? To what extent can such systems foster inclusive and equitable learning for diverse learners with special educational needs? To ground this perspective, a thematic analysis of existing literature identifies four dominant themes: task-specific fragmented AI tools, the transition from single-agent to multi-agent systems, limited cross-functional integration, and insufficient focus on inclusivity and accessibility. Findings reveal a clear gap between current AI implementations and the needs of holistic, learner-centered educational ecosystem. The paper synthesizes challenges and outlines future research directions for scalable human-aligned, and inclusive agentic AI platform. The significant contribution is the incorporation of inclusive learning perspectives, highlighting how coordinated agentic multi-agent platform can support diverse learners through adaptive, multimodal interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向高等教育的前瞻性视角：构建集成的、生态级的、多智能体AI平台，通过自主、目标驱动的智能体协调支持教学、学习和行政运营，并特别关注包容性与公平性学习。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理在高等教育中的应用呈碎片化，缺乏能够跨教学、学习和行政职能进行协调规划、推理和自适应决策的集成生态系统级多智能体平台，且对特殊教育需求学习者的包容性关注不足。
AI.method: 采用前瞻性视角分析，通过对现有文献的主题分析，识别出四个主导主题：任务特定碎片化AI工具、从单代理到多代理系统的过渡、有限的跨功能集成、以及对包容性和可及性关注不足。
AI.result: 发现当前AI实现与整体性、以学习者为中心的教育生态系统需求之间存在明显差距，并综合了挑战，概述了可扩展、人类对齐且包容的代理AI平台的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是将包容性学习视角纳入其中，强调协调的多智能体平台如何通过自适应、多模态干预措施支持多样化学习者。
idea_en: A multi-agent AI platform for higher education with interconnected autonomous goal-driven agents that collectively coordinate planning, reasoning and adaptive decision-making across teaching, learning and administrative functions.
An agentic system that provides adaptive multimodal interventions for diverse learners with special educational needs within a coordinated multi-agent educational ecosystem.
A cross-functional integration framework enabling seamless coordination between instructional AI agents, learning support agents, and administrative AI agents in tertiary education.
A human-aligned agentic AI architecture that balances autonomous decision-making with human oversight in educational settings.
idea_ch: 一种高等教育多智能体AI平台，由互联的自主目标驱动智能体组成，可在教学、学习和行政功能之间集体协调规划、推理和自适应决策。
一种在协调的多智能体教育生态系统中，为有特殊教育需求的多样化学习者提供自适应多模态干预的代理系统。
一种跨功能集成框架，能够在高等教育中实现教学AI代理、学习支持代理和行政AI代理之间的无缝协调运作。
一种人类对齐的代理AI架构，在教育环境中平衡自主决策与人工监督之间的关系。

title: Parallelizing Counterfactual Regret Minimization
comment: This paper contains and extends ideas that were originally in arxiv:2408.14778
summary: Parallelization has played an instrumental role in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), drastically reducing the time taken to train and evaluate large AI models. In contrast to its impact in the broader field of AI, applying parallelization to computational game solving is relatively unexplored, despite its great potential. In this paper, we parallelize the family of counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) algorithms, which were central to important breakthroughs for solving large imperfect-information games. We present a generalized parallelization framework, reframing CFR as a series of linear algebra operations. Then, existing techniques for parallelizing linear algebra operations can be applied to accelerate CFR. We also describe how our technique can be applied to other tabular members of the CFR family of algorithms, including the state-of-the-art, such as CFR+, discounted CFR, and predictive variants of CFR. Experimentally, we show that our CFR implementation on a GPU is up to four orders of magnitude faster than Google DeepMind OpenSpiel's CFR implementations on a CPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）算法家族并行化的通用框架，通过将CFR重构为一系列线性代数运算，利用GPU加速，在大型不完美信息博弈求解中实现了相比CPU实现高达四个数量级的加速。
AI.motivation: 尽管并行化在AI领域（如模型训练）取得了巨大成功，但在计算博弈求解（尤其是CFR算法）中的应用却相对未被探索。论文旨在填补这一空白，加速大型不完美信息博弈的求解过程。
AI.method: 提出一个通用并行化框架，将CFR算法重新表述为一系列线性代数运算，从而可以利用已有的线性代数并行化技术（如GPU加速）来加速CFR。该方法也适用于CFR+、折扣CFR、预测变体等CFR家族算法。
AI.result: 在GPU上实现的CFR相比Google DeepMind OpenSpiel在CPU上的CFR实现，速度提升高达四个数量级（即上万倍）。

title: Precise Verification of Transformers through ReLU-Catalyzed Abstraction Refinement
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, the full version of the paper accepted by CAV 2026
summary: Formal verification of transformers has become increasingly important due to their widespread deployment in safety-critical applications. Compared to classic neural networks, the inferences of transformers involve highly complex computations, such as dot products in self-attention layers, rendering their verification extremely difficult. Existing approaches explored over-approximation methods by constructing convex constraints to bound the output ranges of transformers, which can achieve high efficiency. However, they may sacrifice verification precision, and consequently introduce significant approximation error that leads to frequent occurrences of false alarms. In this paper, we propose a transformer verification approach that can achieve improved precision. At the core of our approach is a novel usage of ReLU, by which we represent a precise but non-linear bound for dot products such that we can further exploit the rich body of literature for convex relaxation of ReLU to derive precise bounds. We extend two classic approaches to the context of transformers, a rule-based one and an optimization-based one, resulting in two new frameworks for efficient and precise verification. We evaluate our approaches on different model architectures and robustness properties derived from two datasets about sentiment analysis, and compare with the state-of-the-art baseline approach. Compared to the baseline, our approach can achieve significant precision improvement for most of the verification tasks with acceptable compromise of efficiency, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于ReLU的新型精确边界表示方法用于Transformer形式化验证，通过精确刻画点积运算的非线性边界，结合凸松弛技术，在保持可接受效率的同时显著提升验证精度。
AI.motivation: Transformer在安全关键应用中的广泛部署使得其形式化验证变得重要，但自注意力层中的点积运算导致传统验证方法精度不足、误报率高。
AI.method: 利用ReLU表示点积的精确但非线性的边界，结合凸松弛技术推导精确边界；将基于规则和基于优化的两类经典方法扩展到Transformer验证场景。
AI.result: 在两个情感分析数据集上不同模型架构和鲁棒性属性的验证中，相比基线方法，显著提升了验证精度，同时效率的牺牲在可接受范围内。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法有效提升了Transformer验证的精度，验证了利用ReLU表示精确边界结合凸松弛技术的有效性。
idea_en: A method for precise bound representation of dot products in transformer self-attention layers using a novel ReLU-based formulation, enabling more accurate formal verification.
A framework that combines precise non-linear dot product bounds with convex relaxation techniques for ReLU to achieve efficient and precise transformer verification.
Extension of rule-based and optimization-based verification approaches to transformer architectures using ReLU-defined precise bounds for attention computations.
A technique to reduce false alarms in transformer verification by replacing over-approximation convex constraints with ReLU-based precise boundary representations.

title: Semantic Feature Segmentation for Interpretable Predictive Maintenance in Complex Systems
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Under review at Neural Computing and Applications. Keywords: semantic segmentation, change point detection, fault anticipation
summary: Predictive maintenance in complex systems is often complicated by the heterogeneity and redundancy of monitored variables,which can obscure fault-relevant information and reduce model interpretability. This work proposes a semantic feature segmentation framework that decomposes the monitored feature space into a canonical component,expected to retain the dominant predictive information, and a residual component containing structurally peripheral signals. The segmentation is defined through domain informed criteria and sets up monitoring variables into functional groups reflecting operational mechanisms such as throughput,latency,pressure,network activity,and structural state. To evaluate the effectiveness of this decomposition, we adopt a predictive perspective in which expected predictive risk is used as an operational proxy for task-relevant information. Experimental results obtained through time-aware cross-validation show that the canonical space consistently achieves lower predictive risk than the residual space across multiple temporal configurations, indicating that the semantic segmentation concentrates the most relevant information for fault anticipation. In addition, the canonical segments exhibit significantly stronger intra-segment coherence than inter-segment dependence, and this structural organization remains stable after redundancy reduction. When compared with the full feature space and with a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) representation, the canonical space carries out comparable predictive performance and furthermore preserves the semantic meaning of the original variables. These findings suggest that semantic feature segmentation provides an interpretable and information-preserving decomposition of monitoring signals, enabling competitive predictive performance without sacrificing the operational interpretability required in predictive maintenance applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种语义特征分割框架，将监测特征空间分解为规范分量（保留主要预测信息）和残差分量（外围信号），在保持可解释性的同时实现与全特征空间和PCA相当的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统中的预测性维护常因监测变量的异构性和冗余性而变得困难，这些因素会模糊故障相关信息并降低模型可解释性。
AI.method: 提出语义特征分割框架，通过领域信息标准将监测特征空间分解为规范分量和残差分量；将变量按功能分组（如吞吐量、延迟、压力、网络活动、结构状态）；以预测风险作为任务相关信息量的代理指标进行验证。
AI.result: 规范空间在多种时间配置下持续获得比残差空间更低的预测风险；规范段内一致性显著强于段间依赖性；这种结构组织在降维后保持稳定；与全特征空间和PCA相比，规范空间具有相当的预测性能，同时保留了原始变量的语义含义。
AI.conclusion: 语义特征分割提供了一种可解释且信息保持的监测信号分解方法，能够在预测性维护应用中在不牺牲操作可解释性的前提下实现有竞争力的预测性能。
idea_en: A semantic feature segmentation framework for predictive maintenance that decomposes monitored feature space into canonical and residual components based on domain-informed criteria.
A method for grouping monitoring variables into functional groups (throughput, latency, pressure, network activity, structural state) reflecting operational mechanisms for fault anticipation.
A technique using expected predictive risk as an operational proxy for task-relevant information to evaluate feature segmentation quality in time-series monitoring data.
A semantic segmentation approach that preserves semantic meaning of original variables while achieving comparable predictive performance to PCA, enabling interpretable model deployment.
A domain-informed canonical-residual decomposition method that maintains structural stability after redundancy reduction in multivariate monitoring systems.
idea_ch: 一种面向预测性维护的语义特征分割框架，基于领域信息标准将监测特征空间分解为规范分量和残差分量。
一种将监测变量按运营机制进行功能分组的方法（吞吐量、延迟、压力、网络活动、结构状态），用于故障预测。
一种以预期预测风险作为任务相关信息量的操作代理指标，用于评估时间序列监测数据中特征分割质量的技术。
一种在保持与PCA相当的预测性能的同时保留原始变量语义含义的语义分割方法，支持可解释模型部署。

title: Are Agents Ready to Teach? A Multi-Stage Benchmark for Real-World Teaching Workflows
summary: Language agents are increasingly deployed in complex professional workflows, with tutoring emerging as a particularly high-stakes capability that remains largely unmeasured in existing benchmarks. Effective tutor agents require more than producing correct answers or executing accurate tool calls: a robust tutor must diagnose learner state, adapt support over time, make pedagogically justified decisions grounded in educational evidence, and execute interventions within realistic learning-management systems. We introduce EduAgentBench, a source-grounded benchmark for holistically evaluating tutor agents across the full scope of teaching work. It contains 150 quality-controlled tasks across three capability surfaces: professional pedagogical judgment, situated multi-turn tutoring, and Canvas-style teaching workflow completion. Tasks are constructed through a pedagogical-insight-driven pipeline and evaluated with complementary verification signals and human review. Across a comprehensive evaluation of frontier models, our findings reveal that current models are generally capable of bounded pedagogical judgment, but still fall short of professional teaching standards in situated tutoring and autonomous teaching-workflow execution. To our knowledge, EduAgentBench is the first theory-grounded and realistic benchmark for evaluating the holistic teaching capability of tutor agents, providing a measurement foundation for developing future tutor agents that can support realistic teaching work.

AI.tldr: EduAgentBench 是一个基于教育理论、用于全面评估智能辅导代理（tutor agents）教学能力的基准测试，包含150个任务，覆盖专业教学判断、多轮情境辅导和Canvas式教学工作流三个维度。评估发现现有模型在有限教学判断上尚可，但在情境辅导和自主教学工作流执行上远未达到专业教师水平。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对辅导代理（tutor agents）整体教学能力的评估，尤其是基于教育理论、涵盖诊断学习者状态、适应性支持、教学决策和真实学习管理系统执行等核心教学能力的全面测评。
AI.method: 构建了含150个质量可控任务的基准，覆盖三大能力面：专业教学判断、多轮情境辅导、Canvas风格教学工作流完成。任务通过教学洞察驱动的管道构建，采用互补验证信号和人工审核进行评估。
AI.result: 当前模型在有限的教学判断方面表现尚可，但在情境辅导和自主教学工作流执行方面远未达到专业教学标准。
AI.conclusion: EduAgentBench是首个基于教育理论、用于全面评估辅导代理教学能力的基准，为未来开发能支持真实教学工作的辅导代理提供了评测基础。
idea_en: A pedagogical-insight-driven pipeline for automatically constructing quality-controlled benchmark tasks for evaluating tutor agents, combining educational theory with automated task generation.

A multi-signal verification framework for tutor agent evaluation that uses complementary verification signals (e.g., correctness, pedagogical appropriateness, workflow completeness) combined with human review.
A Canvas-style teaching workflow completion task framework that evaluates language agents' ability to interact with learning management systems (LMS) and execute multi-step instructional workflows.
A situated multi-turn tutoring evaluation methodology that assesses agent ability to diagnose learner state and adapt pedagogical support over time in realistic tutoring scenarios.

A theory-grounded holistic teaching capability measurement framework for tutor agents, covering professional pedagogical judgment, adaptive tutoring, and autonomous workflow execution across a unified benchmark.
idea_ch: 基于教学洞察的自动化任务生成管道，结合教育理论与自动化方法，生成用于评估辅导代理的质量可控基准任务。

情境化多轮辅导评估方法，评估代理在真实辅导场景中诊断学习者状态并随时间自适应调整教学支持的能力。

title: CrystalReasoner: Reasoning and RL for Property-Conditioned Crystal Structure Generation
summary: Generative modeling has emerged as a promising approach for crystal structure discovery. However, existing LLM-based generative models struggle with low-level atomic precision, while diffusion-based methods fall short in integrating high-level scientific knowledge. As a result, generated structures are often invalid, unstable, or do not possess desirable properties. To address this gap, we propose CrystalReasoner (\method), an end-to-end LLM framework that generates crystal structures from natural language instructions through reasoning and alignment. \method introduces physical priors as thinking tokens, which include crystallographic symmetry, local coordination environments and predicted physical properties before generating atomic coordinates. This bridges the gap between natural language and 3D structures. \method then employs reinforcement learning (RL) with a multi-objective, dense reward function to align generation with physical validity, chemical consistency, and thermodynamic stability. For property-conditioned tasks, we design task-specific reward functions and train specialized models for discrete constraints (e.g., space group) and continuous properties (e.g., elasticity, thermal expansion). Empirical results demonstrate that compared to prior works and baselines without thinking traces or RL, \method obtains better performance on diverse metrics, triples S.U.N. ratio, and achieves better performance for property conditioned generation. \method also exhibits adaptive reasoning, increasing reasoning lengths as the number of atoms increases. Our work demonstrates the potential of leveraging thinking traces and RL for generating valid, stable, and property-conditioned crystal structures. Please see our work at https://crystalreasoner.github.io/ .

AI.tldr: CrystalReasoner是一个端到端的LLM框架，通过引入物理先验作为思考令牌（thinking tokens）并结合强化学习（RL）与多目标奖励函数，从自然语言指令生成有效、稳定且符合特定属性的晶体结构。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的生成模型缺乏原子级精度，而扩散方法难以整合高层次科学知识，导致生成的晶体结构常常无效、不稳定或不具备理想性质。
AI.method: 提出CrystalReasoner框架：1) 将物理先验（晶体对称性、局部配位环境、预测物理性质）作为thinking tokens引入LLM；2) 使用强化学习（RL）配合多目标密集奖励函数来对齐物理有效性、化学一致性和热力学稳定性；3) 针对离散约束（空间群）和连续属性（弹性、热膨胀）设计专门的奖励函数和模型。
AI.result: 相比基线方法，CrystalReasoner在多种指标上表现更优，S.U.N.比率（稳定性、有效性、新颖性）提升三倍，属性条件生成性能更好，并展现出自适应推理能力（随原子数增加推理长度增加）。
AI.conclusion: 展示了利用思考令牌和强化学习生成有效、稳定且属性可控的晶体结构的潜力。
idea_en: A method for generating crystal structures by introducing physical priors (crystallographic symmetry, local coordination environments, predicted physical properties) as thinking tokens in an LLM before generating atomic coordinates.
A reinforcement learning framework with multi-objective dense reward function for aligning crystal structure generation with physical validity, chemical consistency, and thermodynamic stability.

Task-specific reward functions and specialized models for discrete constraints (e.g., space group) and continuous properties (e.g., elasticity, thermal expansion) in property-conditioned crystal generation.
Adaptive reasoning mechanism in crystal generation that increases reasoning length proportionally to the number of atoms in the target structure.
An end-to-end LLM-based crystal structure generation system that bridges natural language instructions to 3D atomic coordinates through reasoning and alignment.

title: Herculean: An Agentic Benchmark for Financial Intelligence
summary: As AI agents improve, the central question is no longer whether they can solve isolated well-defined financial tasks, but whether they can reliably carry out financial professional work. Existing financial benchmarks offer only a partial view of this ability, as they primarily evaluate static competencies such as question answering, retrieval, summarization, and classification. We introduce Herculean, the first skilled benchmark for agentic financial intelligence spanning four representative workflows, including Trading, Hedging, Market Insights, and Auditing. Each workflow is instantiated as a standardized MCP-based skill environment with its own tools, interaction dynamics, constraints, and success criteria, enabling consistent end-to-end assessment of heterogeneous agent systems. Across frontier agents, we find agents perform relatively well on Trading and Market Insights, but struggle substantially on Hedging and Auditing, where long-horizon coordination, state consistency, and structured verification are critical. Overall, our results point to a key gap in current agents in turning financial reasoning into dependable workflow execution in high-stakes financial workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Herculean，首个面向金融智能体的技能型基准测试，涵盖交易、对冲、市场洞察和审计四个工作流，基于MCP协议构建标准化评估环境。实验表明现有智能体在交易和市场洞察上表现尚可，但在需长周期协调、状态一致性和结构化验证的对冲与审计任务中表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准仅评估静态能力（问答、检索、摘要、分类），无法衡量AI智能体在真实金融专业工作中的端到端执行能力，缺乏对复杂工作流场景的标准化评估。
AI.method: 设计四个代表性金融工作流（交易、对冲、市场洞察、审计），每个工作流基于MCP（Model Context Protocol）构建标准化技能环境，配备专用工具、交互规则、约束条件和成功标准，实现对异构智能体系统的一致评估。
AI.result: 前沿智能体在交易和市场洞察工作流中表现相对良好，但在对冲和审计工作流中明显不足，特别是在长周期协调、状态一致性和结构化验证方面存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI智能体在将金融推理转化为可靠的高风险工作流执行方面存在关键缺口，需要进一步提升在长周期协调、状态管理和结构化验证方面的能力。
idea_en: MCP-based standardized skill environment for financial agent evaluation that provides consistent end-to-end assessment across heterogeneous agent systems by encapsulating workflows with dedicated tools, interaction dynamics, constraints, and success criteria.

State consistency verification mechanism for financial agents that detects and resolves state drift during long-horizon hedging and auditing workflows through structured verification checkpoints.
Multi-agent coordination framework for auditing workflows that decomposes complex financial verification tasks into structured sub-tasks with dependency tracking and cross-validation.

Risk-constrained agent action space for high-stakes financial workflows that enforces hard constraints (e.g., position limits, compliance rules) at the environment level rather than relying solely on agent reasoning.

审计工作流的多智能体协作框架，将复杂金融验证任务分解为带有依赖追踪和交叉验证的结构化子任务。

title: Uncovering the Representation Geometry of Minimal Cores in Overcomplete Reasoning Traces
summary: Language models often generate long chain-of-thought traces, but it remains unclear how much of this reasoning is necessary for preserving the final prediction. We study this through the lens of overcomplete reasoning traces: generated traces that contain more intermediate steps than are needed to support the model's answer. We define the minimal core as the smallest subset of steps that preserves either the final answer or predictive distribution, and introduce metrics for compression ratio, redundancy mass, step necessity, and necessity concentration. Across six deliberative reasoning benchmarks spanning arithmetic, competition mathematics, expert scientific reasoning, and commonsense multi-hop QA, we find substantial overcompleteness: on average, 46% of steps are removable under greedy minimal-core extraction while preserving the original answer in 86% of cases. We also find that predictive support is concentrated: the top three steps account for 65% of measured necessity mass on average. Beyond compression, minimal cores expose a cleaner geometry of reasoning: compared with full traces, they improve correct-incorrect trace separation by 11 points, reduce estimated intrinsic dimensionality by 34%, and transfer across model families with 85% off-diagonal answer retention. Theoretically, we establish existence of minimal sufficient subsets, local irreducibility guarantees for greedy elimination, and certificates of overcompleteness and sparse necessity. Together, these results suggest that full reasoning traces are often verbose and overcomplete, while minimal cores isolate the effective support underlying language-model predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型生成的长链式推理轨迹的过度完备性，发现平均46%的推理步骤是冗余的，并提出了"最小核心"概念来提取必要的推理步骤。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常生成冗长的链式推理，但其中多少推理步骤对最终预测是必要的尚不清楚。作者希望通过识别冗余步骤，量化推理轨迹的过度完备性。
AI.method: 定义"最小核心"为保留最终答案或预测分布的最小步骤子集；引入压缩比、冗余质量、步骤必要性、必要性集中度等指标；在6个推理基准（算术、竞赛数学、科学推理、常识多跳QA）上评估；建立理论保证（最小充分子集存在性、贪婪消除的局部不可约性、过度完备性和稀疏必要性的证书）。
AI.result: 平均46%的步骤在贪婪最小核心提取下可移除，86%情况下保留原答案；前3个步骤贡献65%的必要性质量；最小核心相比完整轨迹提升了11%的正确-错误轨迹分离度，减少了34%的估计内在维度，跨模型家族转移时达到85%的对角线外答案保留率。
AI.conclusion: 完整推理轨迹往往冗长且过度完备，而最小核心能够隔离语言模型预测背后的有效支持。
idea_en: A method for identifying a minimal core subset of reasoning steps from a language model's chain-of-thought trace that preserves the final prediction, using greedy elimination with local irreducibility guarantees
A system for measuring reasoning step necessity and redundancy concentration in language model outputs, enabling compression ratio and necessity mass quantification
A technique for improving correct-incorrect reasoning trace separation by extracting minimal cores that reveal cleaner geometry of reasoning
A cross-model transfer method where minimal cores extracted from one language model can be applied to another model family with high answer retention
A certificate mechanism for guaranteeing overcompleteness and sparse necessity in language model reasoning traces
idea_ch: 一种从语言模型链式推理轨迹中识别保留最终预测的"最小核心"步骤子集的方法，利用具有局部不可约性保证的贪婪消除算法

一种用于保证语言模型推理轨迹过度完备性和稀疏必要性的证书机制

title: Nexus : An Agentic Framework for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting is not just numerical extrapolation, but often requires reasoning with unstructured contextual data such as news or events. While specialized Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) excel at forecasting based on numerical patterns, they remain unaware to real-world textual signals. Conversely, while LLMs are emerging as zero-shot forecasters, their performance remains uneven across domains and contextual grounding. To bridge this gap, we introduce Nexus, a multi-agent forecasting framework that decomposes prediction into specialized stages: isolating macro-level and micro-level temporal fluctuations, and integrating contextual information when available before synthesizing a final forecast. This decomposition enables Nexus to adapt from seasonal signals to volatile, event-driven information without relying on external statistical anchors or monolithic prompting. We show that current-generation LLMs possess substantially stronger intrinsic forecasting ability than previously recognized, depending critically on how numerical and contextual reasoning are organized. Evaluated on data strictly succeeding LLM knowledge cutoffs spanning Zillow real estate metrics and volatile stock market equities, Nexus consistently matches or outperforms state-of-the-art TSFMs and strong LLM baselines. Beyond numerical accuracy, Nexus produces high-quality reasoning traces that explicitly show the fundamental drivers behind each forecast. Our results establish that real-world forecasting is an agentic reasoning problem extending well beyond only sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: Nexus提出了一种多智能体预测框架，将时间序列预测分解为宏观/微观波动分离、上下文信息整合和最终预测合成等专门阶段，使LLM能够有效利用非结构化文本数据进行预测，在Zillow房产和股票市场数据上匹配或超越最先进的时序基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型(TSFMs)擅长数值模式但无法利用真实世界的文本信号（如新闻、事件），而LLM作为零样本预测器在不同领域的表现参差不齐。需要一种方法将数值模式与上下文信息有效结合。
AI.method: Nexus采用多智能体框架，将预测分解为多个专门阶段：1) 隔离宏观和微观时间波动；2) 整合可用的上下文信息；3) 综合生成最终预测。这种分解使得系统可以适应从季节性信号到事件驱动的波动信息。
AI.result: 在Zillow房地产指标和股票市场数据上，Nexus一致匹配或超越了最先进的TSFMs和强LLM基线。同时生成高质量推理轨迹，明确展示每个预测背后的驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 现实世界的时间序列预测本质上是一个智能体推理问题，远超单纯的序列建模。当前LLM的内在预测能力比先前认为的要强得多，关键在于如何组织数值和上下文推理。
idea_en: Multi-agent forecasting framework decomposing time series prediction into macro-level fluctuation isolation, micro-level fluctuation isolation, and contextual information integration stages
Method for separating seasonal signals from volatile event-driven information without relying on external statistical anchors or monolithic prompting
LLM-based forecasting system that generates high-quality reasoning traces explicitly showing fundamental drivers behind each forecast
Technique for organizing numerical and contextual reasoning in LLMs to substantially improve intrinsic zero-shot forecasting ability

title: Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis
summary: We pursue a vision for self-improving language models in which the model does not merely generate problems or traces to imitate, but constructs the environments that train it. In zero-data reasoning RL, this reframes self-improvement from a data-generation loop into an environment-construction loop, where each artifact is a reusable executable object that samples instances, computes references, and scores responses. Whether this vision sustains improvement hinges on a single property: the environments must exhibit stable solve--verify asymmetry, the model must be able to write an oracle once that it cannot reliably execute in natural language on fresh instances. This asymmetry takes two complementary forms. Some tasks are algorithmically hard to reason through but trivial as code: a dynamic program or graph traversal, compiled once, yields unboundedly many calibrated instances. Others are intrinsically hard to solve but easy to verify, like planted subset-sum or constraint satisfaction. Both create a durable gap between proposing and solving that the policy cannot close by gaming the verifier, and it is this gap that keeps reward informative as the learner improves. We instantiate this view in EvoEnv, a single-policy generator, solver method that synthesizes Python environments from ten seeds and admits them only after staged validation, semantic self-review, solver-relative difficulty calibration, and novelty checks. The strongest evidence comes from the already-strong regime: on Qwen3-4B-Thinking, fixed public-data RLVR and fixed hand-crafted environment RLVR reduce the average, while EvoEnv improves it from 72.4 to 74.8, a relative gain of 3.3%. Stable self-improvement, we suggest, depends not on producing more synthetic data, but on models learning to construct worlds whose difficulty stays structurally beyond their own reach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为EvoEnv的自我改进语言模型方法，通过让模型自主构建训练环境（而非仅生成数据）实现持续提升，核心在于保持"求解-验证不对称性"——即模型能写出一次性可用的验证器（oracle），但无法可靠地在新实例上执行自然语言推理。
AI.motivation: 现有自我改进方法依赖模型生成问题或轨迹进行模仿学习，但这种方法存在瓶颈：模型容易"欺骗"验证器，导致奖励信号随模型能力提升而失效。作者旨在打破这一局限，让模型从"数据生成循环"转向"环境构建循环"。
AI.method: 提出EvoEnv框架：(1) 模型从10个种子合成Python环境；(2) 经过阶段验证（语义自审查、求解器相对难度校准、新颖性检查）后才被采纳；(3) 环境作为可重用的可执行对象，能采样实例、计算参考答案、评分响应。核心依赖"求解-验证不对称性"——分为算法难推理易编码（如动态规划）和难求解易验证（如子集和约束满足）两类。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Thinking模型上，固定公共数据RLVR和固定手工环境RLVR均导致平均性能下降，而EvoEnv将性能从72.4提升至74.8，相对增益3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 稳定的自我改进不依赖于产生更多合成数据，而在于模型学会构建"难度始终超出自身当前能力范围"的世界。自我提升的关键是保持求解与验证之间的持久差距，使奖励信号持续有效。
idea_en: A self-improving language model method (EvoEnv) that constructs training environments rather than merely generating data, where each environment is a reusable executable object that can sample instances, compute reference answers, and score responses.
A staged validation pipeline for synthesized training environments, comprising semantic self-review, solver-relative difficulty calibration, and novelty checks before admission to the training loop.

Exploitation of solve-verify asymmetry in environment construction: tasks that are algorithmically hard to reason through but trivial to implement as code (e.g., dynamic programming, graph traversal compiled once yielding unbounded calibrated instances).
Exploitation of solve-verify asymmetry in environment construction: tasks that are intrinsically hard to solve but easy to verify (e.g., planted subset-sum or constraint satisfaction problems).

A zero-data reasoning reinforcement learning framework that reframes self-improvement from a data-generation loop into an environment-construction loop, maintaining a durable gap between proposing and solving that prevents the policy from gaming the verifier.
Single-policy generator-solver method that synthesizes Python environments from seeds and ensures the environments maintain difficulty structurally beyond the model's current capability.

title: Coding Agent Is Good As World Simulator
summary: World models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for building interactive simulation environments, with recent video-based approaches demonstrating impressive progress in generating visually plausible dynamics. However, because these models typically infer dynamics from video and represent them in latent states, they do not explicitly enforce physical constraints. As a result, the generated video rollouts are not physically plausible, exhibiting unstable contacts, distorted shapes, or inconsistent motion. In this paper, we present an agentic framework constructing physics-based world models through executable simulation code. The framework coordinates planning, code generation, visual review, and physics analysis agents. The planning agent converts the natural language prompt into a structured scene plan, the code agent implements it as executable simulation code, and the visual review agent provide visual feedback while the physics analysis agent checks physical consistency. The code is iteratively revised based on the feedback until the simulation matches the prompt reqirements and physical constraints. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity and visual quality, which could be applied to various scenarios including driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于可执行模拟代码的物理世界模型智能体框架，通过协调规划、代码生成、视觉审查和物理分析智能体，生成符合物理约束的仿真内容，在物理准确性、指令忠实度和视觉质量上优于视频基模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频基世界模型虽然能生成视觉上逼真的动态内容，但由于从视频推断潜状态表示，没有明确施加物理约束，导致生成的视频展开存在不稳定的接触、形状扭曲或运动不一致等物理不合理的现象。
AI.method: 提出一个智能体框架，包含四个协同工作的智能体：规划智能体将自然语言提示转换为结构化场景计划；代码智能体将场景计划实现为可执行的模拟代码；视觉审查智能体提供视觉反馈；物理分析智能体检查物理一致性。基于这些反馈迭代修订代码，直到模拟结果符合提示要求和物理约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架在物理准确性、指令忠实度和视觉质量方面优于先进的视频基模型，并可应用于驾驶模拟和具身机器人任务等多种场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过将世界模型构建为可执行的模拟代码并结合多智能体迭代反馈机制，能够有效保证生成内容的物理合理性，为构建物理可信的交互仿真环境提供了新范式。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework for constructing physics-based world models that converts natural language prompts into executable simulation code through coordinated planning, code generation, visual review, and physics analysis agents.

An iterative revision mechanism for simulation code that incorporates both visual feedback and physics consistency checks to ensure generated simulations satisfy both prompt requirements and physical constraints.
A physics analysis agent specifically designed to detect and enforce physical plausibility in simulation outputs, checking for stable contacts, consistent motion, and shape integrity.
A method for generating physically plausible interactive simulation environments from natural language descriptions without requiring pre-recorded video data.

title: Metis AI: The Overlooked Middle Zone Between AI-Native and World-Movers
summary: The dominant discourse on AI limitations frames the boundary of AI capability as a divide between digital tasks (where AI excels) and physical tasks (where embodiment is required). We argue this framing misses the most consequential boundary: the one within digital tasks. We identify a class of tasks we call Metis AI, named for the Greek concept of metis (practical, contextual knowledge), that are performed entirely on computers yet resist reliable AI automation. These tasks are not computationally intractable; they are institutionally, socially, and normatively entangled in ways that defeat algorithmic approaches. We distinguish constitutive metis (knowledge destroyed by the act of formalization) from operational metis (system-specific familiarity that automation can progressively absorb), and propose five structural characteristics that define the Metis AI zone: consequential irreversibility, relational irreducibility, normative open texture, adversarial co-evolution, and accountability anchoring. We ground each in established theory from across the social sciences, philosophy, and humanitarian practice, argue that these characteristics are properties of the tasks themselves rather than limitations of current models, and show that the appropriate design response is not better automation but centaur architectures in which humans lead and AI supports.

AI.tldr: 论文提出数字任务中存在一类名为"Metis AI"的任务，这类任务完全在计算机上执行，但因涉及制度、社会和规范层面的复杂性而难以被AI可靠自动化，并提出了五种结构性特征及相应的"半人马架构"设计思路。
AI.motivation: 反驳主流观点认为AI能力的边界在于数字任务与物理任务之分，指出更关键的边界存在于数字任务内部——有一类任务虽然完全数字化，却因深深嵌入制度、社会和规范环境中而无法被算法有效处理。
AI.method: 借鉴希腊概念"metis"（实践性、情境性知识），将Metis AI分为两类：（1）构成性metis（形式化过程本身会破坏的知识）；（2）操作性metis（可通过自动化逐步吸收的系统特定熟悉度）。提出五种结构性特征：后果不可逆性、关系不可还原性、规范开放纹理、对抗性共同演化、问责锚定性，并基于社会科学、哲学和人道主义实践理论进行论证。
AI.result: 证明了这些特征是任务本身的属性而非当前模型的局限，指出适当的设计响应不是更好的自动化，而是"半人马架构"——人类主导、AI辅助的协作模式。
AI.conclusion: 应重新思考人机分工，认识到某些数字任务的核心价值恰恰在于人类不可替代的实践智慧和情境判断能力。

A formalization-preservation technique for distinguishing between constitutive metis (knowledge destroyed by formalization) and operational metis (knowledge that can be progressively absorbed by automation), allowing selective automation of digital workflows.

title: A Unified Knowledge Embedded Reinforcement Learning-based Framework for Generalized Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) is a fundamental NP-hard problem with broad applications in logistics and transportation. Real-world CVRPs often involve diverse objectives and complex constraints, such as time windows or backhaul requirements, motivating the development of a unified solution framework. Recent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches have shown promise in combinatorial optimization, yet they rely on end-to-end learning and lack explicit problem-solving knowledge, limiting solution quality. In this paper, we propose a knowledge-embedded framework inspired by the Route-First Cluster-Second heuristics. It incorporates knowledge at two levels: (1) decomposing CVRPs into the route-first and cluster-second subproblems, and (2) leveraging dynamic programming to solve the second subproblem, whose results guide the RL-based constructive solver to solve the first problem. To mitigate partial observability caused by problem decomposition, we introduce a unified history-enhanced context processing module. Extensive experiments show that this framework achieves superior solution quality compared with state-of-the-art learning-based methods, with a smaller gap to classical heuristics, demonstrating strong generalization across diverse CVRP variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种知识嵌入的强化学习框架，通过"先路线后聚类"的启发式分解策略，结合动态规划与强化学习，有效求解带容量约束的车辆路径问题及其变种。
AI.motivation: 现实中的CVRP问题目标多样、约束复杂，现有端到端强化学习方法缺乏显式问题求解知识，解质量有限。
AI.method: 提出知识嵌入框架，将CVRP分解为"先路线后聚类"两个子问题，利用动态规划求解第二子问题，结果引导基于RL的构造式求解器解决第一子问题，并引入统一历史增强上下文处理模块缓解部分可观测性问题。
AI.result: 与最先进的学习方法相比，解质量更优，与经典启发式算法差距更小，在多种CVRP变种上展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 知识嵌入的RL框架能有效提升CVRP求解质量，具有良好的泛化性，为组合优化问题提供了新思路。
idea_en: A knowledge-embedded RL framework for CVRP that decomposes the problem into route-first and cluster-second subproblems using dynamic programming guidance.
A unified history-enhanced context processing module that mitigates partial observability caused by problem decomposition in RL-based vehicle routing.
A hybrid approach combining route-first cluster-second heuristics with reinforcement learning for capacitated vehicle routing with time windows and backhaul constraints.
A dynamic programming module that solves the cluster-second subproblem and provides explicit guidance signals to the RL constructive solver.
A method for embedding explicit combinatorial optimization knowledge into end-to-end RL architectures for NP-hard routing problems.
idea_ch: 基于知识嵌入的强化学习框架，将带容量约束车辆路径问题分解为路线优先与聚类次优两个子问题，并利用动态规划进行求解引导。

将路线优先-聚类次优启发式与强化学习相结合的混合方法，适用于含时间窗和回程约束的车辆路径问题。
动态规划模块，用于求解聚类次优子问题，并为强化学习构造式求解器提供显式引导信号。
将显式组合优化知识嵌入端到端强化学习架构中，用于求解NP难路由问题的方法。

title: DVMap: Fine-Grained Pluralistic Value Alignment via High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of ACL 2026
summary: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) typically rely on coarse-grained national labels for pluralistic value alignment. However, such macro-level supervision often obscures intra-country value heterogeneity, yielding a loose alignment. We argue that resolving this limitation requires shifting from national labels to multi-dimensional demographic constraints, which can identify groups with predictable, high-consensus value preference. To this end, we propose DVMap (High-Consensus Demographic-Value Mapping), a framework for fine-grained pluralistic value alignment. In this framework, we first present a demographic archetype extraction strategy to construct a high-quality value alignment corpus of 56,152 samples from the World Values Survey (WVS) by strictly retaining respondents with consistent value preferences under identical demographics. Over this corpus, we introduce a Structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism that explicitly guides LLMs to reason about demographic-value correlations. Subsequently, we employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to achieve adaptive anchoring of value distributions. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we further establish a triple-generalization benchmark (spanning cross-demographic, cross-country, and cross-value) comprising 21,553 samples. Experimental results demonstrate that DVMap effectively learns the manifold mapping from demographics to values, exhibiting strong generalization and robustness. On cross-demographic tests, Qwen3-8B-DVMap achieves 48.6% accuracy, surpassing the advanced open-source LLM DeepSeek-v3.2 (45.1%). The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/EnlightenedAI/DVMap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DVMap框架，通过从粗粒度国家标签转向多维人口统计约束，实现细粒度的多元价值对齐。该框架包含人口统计原型提取策略构建高质量语料库、结构化思维链推理机制以及GRPO自适应锚定价值分布，在跨人口统计、跨国家、跨价值的三重泛化测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM依赖于粗粒度的国家标签进行多元价值对齐，但国家层面的宏观监督掩盖了国内的价值异质性，导致对齐松散。需要从国家标签转向多维人口统计约束，以识别具有可预测、高共识价值偏好的群体。
AI.method: 1) 提出人口统计原型提取策略，从WVS数据中严格保留在相同人口统计特征下具有一致价值偏好的受访者，构建56,152条高质量价值对齐语料。2) 引入结构化思维链机制，显式引导LLM推理人口统计与价值之间的相关性。3) 采用GRPO实现价值分布的自适应锚定。
AI.result: 在跨人口统计测试中，Qwen3-8B-DVMap达到48.6%的准确率，超过先进开源模型DeepSeek-v3.2的45.1%。在跨国家、跨价值测试中同样表现出强泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DVMap能有效学习从人口统计到价值的流形映射，实现细粒度多元价值对齐，为LLM的价值观对齐提供新范式。

A Structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism that explicitly guides LLMs to reason about correlations between demographic attributes and value preferences.
A framework (DVMap) using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to achieve adaptive anchoring of value distributions based on fine-grained demographic constraints.
A triple-generalization benchmark system (spanning cross-demographic, cross-country, and cross-value dimensions) for rigorously evaluating pluralistic value alignment in LLMs.
A method for shifting from coarse-grained national labels to multi-dimensional demographic constraints for fine-grained pluralistic value alignment in LLMs.

title: BEAM: Binary Expert Activation Masking for Dynamic Routing in MoE
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enhance the efficiency of large language models by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, standard MoE employs a fixed Top-K routing strategy, leading to redundant computation and suboptimal inference latency. Existing acceleration methods either require costly retraining with architectural changes or suffer from severe performance drop at high sparsity due to train-inference mismatch. To address these limitations, we propose BEAM (Binary Expert Activation Masking), a novel method that learns token-adaptive expert selection via trainable binary masks. With a straight-through estimator and an auxiliary regularization loss, BEAM induces dynamic expert sparsity through end-to-end training while maintaining model capability. We further implement an efficient custom CUDA kernel for BEAM, ensuring seamless integration with the vLLM inference framework. Experiments show that BEAM retains over 98\% of the original model's performance while reducing MoE layer FLOPs by up to 85\%, achieving up to 2.5$\times$ faster decoding and 1.4$\times$ higher throughput, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical, plug-and-play solution for efficient MoE inference.

AI.tldr: BEAM通过可训练二值掩码实现令牌自适应的专家选择，在不需重新训练的情况下将MoE模型解码速度提升2.5倍，同时保持98%以上原始性能。
AI.motivation: 标准MoE使用固定的Top-K路由策略导致冗余计算和次优推理延迟，现有加速方法要么需要昂贵重训练并改变架构，要么在高稀疏度下因训练-推理不匹配而性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出BEAM方法，通过可训练的二值掩码学习令牌自适应的专家选择，利用直通估计器和辅助正则化损失进行端到端训练，诱导动态专家稀疏性；并实现自定义CUDA内核与vLLM推理框架无缝集成。
AI.result: 保持原始模型98%以上性能，MoE层FLOPs减少高达85%，解码速度提升2.5倍，吞吐量提升1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: BEAM是一种实用、即插即用的高效MoE推理解决方案，在不牺牲模型能力的前提下显著加速推理。
idea_en: Binary Expert Activation Masking (BEAM) for learning token-adaptive expert selection via trainable binary masks in MoE architectures
Straight-through estimator combined with auxiliary regularization loss for end-to-end training of dynamic expert sparsity
Custom CUDA kernel implementation for BEAM that seamlessly integrates with vLLM inference framework

title: Synthesizing POMDP Policies: Sampling Meets Model-checking via Learning
comment: Paper accepted at 38th International Conference on Computer Aided Verification (CAV 2026), Lisbon, Portugal, July 2026
summary: Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are the standard framework for decision-making under uncertainty. While sampling-based methods scale well, they lack formal correctness guarantees, making them unsuitable for safety-critical applications. Conversely, formal synthesis techniques provide correctness-by-construction but often struggle with scalability, as general POMDP synthesis is undecidable. To bridge this gap, we propose a synthesis framework that integrates sampling, automata learning, and model-checking. Inspired by Angluin's $L^*$ algorithm, our approach utilizes sampling as a membership oracle and model-checking as an equivalence oracle. This enables the synthesis of finite-state controllers with formal guarantees, provided the sampling-induced policy is regular. We establish a relative completeness result for this framework. Experimental results from our prototypical implementation demonstrate that this method successfully solves threshold-safety problems that remain challenging for existing formal synthesis tools. We believe our algorithm serves as a valuable component in a portfolio approach to tackling the inherent difficulty of POMDP synthesis problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合采样、自动机学习和模型检测的POMDP综合框架，通过将采样作为成员查询、模型检测作为等价查询，能够综合出具有形式化保证的有限状态控制器，适用于安全关键应用。
AI.motivation: 现有POMDP方法存在两难：基于采样的方法可扩展但缺乏形式化正确性保证，不适合安全关键应用；形式化综合技术虽能提供正确性保证但可扩展性差，且一般POMDP综合问题不可判定。
AI.method: 受Angluin L*算法启发，提出一种综合框架：将采样作为成员查询(计算点估计策略)，将模型检测作为等价查询(验证策略是否满足规范)，通过自动机学习迭代精炼有限状态控制器，直到通过模型检测验证。
AI.result: 原型实现成功解决了对现有形式化综合工具具有挑战性的阈值安全问题，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该算法可作为组合方法中的有价值组件，用于应对POMDP综合问题的固有困难。
idea_en: A POMDP synthesis framework integrating sampling as membership oracle and model-checking as equivalence oracle, enabling finite-state controller synthesis with formal guarantees
An automata learning-based approach (inspired by L* algorithm) for iteratively constructing provably correct policies in POMDPs
A relative completeness result establishing that any regular sampling-induced policy can be synthesized with formal guarantees
A portfolio approach combining sampling scalability with formal verification correctness for POMDP threshold-safety problems

相对完备性证明：任何正则的采样诱导策略均可通过形式化方法综合得到
一种组合方法策略：将采样的可扩展性与形式化验证的正确性相结合，用于解决POMDP阈值安全问题

title: Prompting Policies for Multi-step Reasoning and Tool-Use in Black-box LLMs with Iterative Distillation of Experience
summary:
The shift toward interacting with frozen, "black-box" Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed prompt engineering from a heuristic exercise into a critical optimization challenge. We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework for training learned prompting policies via iterative distillation of experience. In this architecture, a lightweight prompter model is optimized to maximize task-specific rewards for a larger, frozen worker LLM. By utilizing a contrastive experience buffer that couples scalar rewards with dense textual critiques, our approach effectively amortizes iterative prompt refinement into single-shot policy weights.
  Our experimental analysis focuses on the Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) and Tau-bench suites, covering a diverse range of multi-step reasoning and tool-use tasks. We demonstrate significant gains, improving performance from 55% to 90% in logic-intensive reasoning and 74% to 91% in tool-use tasks. Furthermore, we analyze the structural evolution of prompts, demonstrating how the policy discovers specialized algorithmic heuristics. We provide comprehensive comparisons against state-of-the-art evolutionary baselines like GEPA, showing that iterative distillation achieves superior performance with higher sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种强化学习框架，通过迭代蒸馏经验来训练轻量级提示策略模型，优化冻结的大语言模型在特定任务上的表现，在推理和工具使用任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 将提示工程从启发式方法转变为关键的优化问题，解决黑盒大语言模型交互中提示优化的挑战。
AI.method: 采用强化学习架构，训练轻量级prompter模型以最大化冻结worker LLM的任务奖励，利用对比经验缓冲区耦合标量奖励与文本批评，将迭代提示优化摊销为单次策略权重。
AI.result: 在BBEH和Tau-bench基准上，逻辑推理任务从55%提升至90%，工具使用任务从74%提升至91%，性能优于GEPA等进化基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 迭代蒸馏的强化学习方法能高效学习提示策略，发现专用算法启发式，样本效率优于进化方法。
idea_en: Reinforcement Learning framework for training learned prompting policies via iterative distillation of experience, where a lightweight prompter model is optimized to maximize task-specific rewards for a frozen worker LLM.
Contrastive experience buffer that couples scalar rewards with dense textual critiques to amortize iterative prompt refinement into single-shot policy weights.
Iterative distillation architecture that discovers specialized algorithmic heuristics through structural evolution of prompts.
Sample-efficient prompt optimization method outperforming evolutionary baselines like GEPA through RL-based iterative distillation.

对比经验缓冲区机制，将标量奖励与密集文本批评耦合，将迭代提示优化摊销为单次策略权重。
迭代蒸馏架构能够通过提示的结构演化发现专用算法启发式策略。
基于强化学习迭代蒸馏的提示优化方法，相比GEPA等进化基线具有更高的样本效率。

title: Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ): A Framework for Measuring Organizational AI Impact
summary: The Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ) is a composite metric intended to quantify the depth to which AI systems are integrated into organizational work and their impact. Rather than treating access counts or aggregate token volume as sufficient evidence of impact, IIQ combines a novelty-weighted, time-decayed token stock with usage frequency, a grace-period recency gate, organizational leverage, task complexity, and autonomy. The formulation produces a raw Intelligence Adoption Index (IAI) and a normalized 0-1000 IIQ index for comparison between heterogeneous users and units. We also derive sub-daily update rules and a bounded interpretation layer for estimated efficiency and financial impact. The paper positions IIQ as a deployment-oriented measurement framework: a formal proposal for tracking AI embedding in workflows, not a direct measure of model capability or a substitute for causal productivity evaluation. Synthetic scenarios illustrate how the revised metric distinguishes between frequent low-leverage use, semantically repetitive prompting, and more autonomous, higher-consequence AI-assisted work.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为IIQ的综合指标，用于量化AI系统在组织工作中的集成深度和影响，结合了新颖性加权、时间衰减、使用频率、组织杠杆、任务复杂性和自主性等多个维度。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI使用度量（如访问次数、token总量）无法充分反映AI系统对组织工作的真实影响深度，需要一种更全面的部署导向测量框架。
AI.method: 构建Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ)指标，包含：新颖性加权+时间衰减的token存量、使用频率、宽限期最近性门控、组织杠杆、任务复杂性、自主性；生成原始IAI分数和归一化0-1000 IIQ指数；推导亚日更新规则和有界解释层。
AI.result: 合成场景表明IIQ能够区分低杠杆高频使用、语义重复提示与更高自主性、高后果的AI辅助工作。
AI.conclusion: IIQ是一个部署导向测量框架，用于追踪AI在工作流中的嵌入程度，而非直接衡量模型能力或替代因果生产力评估。
idea_en: A composite metric (IIQ) combining novelty-weighted time-decayed token stock, usage frequency, recency gate, organizational leverage, task complexity, and autonomy for quantifying AI integration depth.
A normalized 0-1000 Intelligence Impact Quotient (IIQ) index enabling comparison across heterogeneous users and organizational units.
Sub-daily update rules for real-time tracking of AI embedding in organizational workflows.
A bounded interpretation layer for estimating efficiency and financial impact from the IIQ metric.

基于IIQ指标的有界解释层，用于估算效率和财务影响。

title: Stateful Reasoning via Insight Replay
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has become a foundation for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, but recent studies show that its benefits do not scale monotonically with chain length: while longer CoT generally enables a model to tackle harder problems, on a given problem, accuracy typically increases with CoT length up to a point, after which it declines. We identify a major cause of this phenomenon: as the CoT grows, the model's attention to critical insights produced earlier in the trace gradually weakens, making those insights progressively less accessible when they are most needed. Therefore, we propose \textbf{InsightReplay}, a stateful reasoning approach in which the model periodically extracts critical insights from its reasoning trace and replays them near the active generation frontier, keeping them accessible as the reasoning scales. Extensive experiments on a $\mathbf{2}\!\times\!\mathbf{3}\!\times\!\mathbf{4}$ benchmark grid, covering model scales $\{\text{8B}, \text{30B}\}$, model families $\{\text{Qwen3.5}, \text{DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen}, \text{Gemma-4}\}$, and reasoning benchmarks $\{\text{AIME}, \text{HMMT}, \text{GPQA Diamond}, \text{LiveCodeBench v5}\}$, show that 3-round InsightReplay yields accuracy gains across \textbf{all 24 settings}, with an averaged improvement of $\mathbf{+1.65}$ points over standard CoT, and a largest single-setting gain of $\mathbf{+9.2}$ points on R1-Distill-32B's LiveCodeBench v5 subset. Our results suggest that the effectiveness of test-time scaling depends not only on how much a model reasons, but also on whether critical intermediate insights remain accessible throughout long reasoning trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出InsightReplay方法，通过周期性提取并回放推理轨迹中的关键洞察来解决长链思维中注意力衰减问题，在24种设置下平均提升1.65个百分点的准确率。
AI.motivation: 长链思维推理中，随着链长度增长，模型对早期产生的关键洞察的关注逐渐减弱，导致准确率在达到某个长度后反而下降。
AI.method: 提出InsightReplay状态推理方法，周期性地从推理轨迹中提取关键洞察，并将其回放到活跃生成前沿附近，确保关键洞察在长推理过程中保持可访问性。
AI.result: 在2×3×4基准网格（涵盖8B/30B规模、Qwen3.5/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen/Gemma-4模型族、AIME/HMMT/GPQA Diamond/LiveCodeBench v5基准）上，3轮InsightReplay在所有24种设置下均带来准确率提升，平均提升1.65个百分点，最大单设置提升9.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 测试时扩展的有效性不仅取决于模型推理的量，还取决于关键中间洞察在长推理轨迹中是否保持可访问性。
idea_en: A stateful reasoning method (InsightReplay) that periodically extracts critical insights from the reasoning trace and replays them near the active generation frontier to maintain accessibility during long-chain reasoning.
A mechanism to combat attention decay in Chain-of-Thought reasoning by selectively preserving and re-integrating earlier critical insights into the ongoing generation process.
A dynamic insight extraction and replay system that operates during test-time scaling to improve reasoning accuracy without requiring additional model training.
A method for improving long-chain reasoning performance by maintaining a persistent memory of key intermediate insights and re-injecting them at strategic points during generation.
idea_ch: 一种状态化推理方法(InsightReplay)，周期性从推理轨迹中提取关键洞察并将其回放到活跃生成前沿附近，以在长链推理过程中保持关键信息的可访问性
一种对抗链式思维推理中注意力衰减的机制，通过选择性保留并重新整合早期关键洞察到当前生成过程中
一种在测试时扩展期间运行的动态洞察提取与回放系统，无需额外模型训练即可提升推理准确率
